japanese: どんな理由があろうと、せっかく軌道に乗せた貿易を失墜させたのは大失態だ。
romaji: donna riyuu gaarouto, sekkaku kidou ni nose ta boueki o shittsui sasetanoha daishittai da.
meaning: Whatever the reason, forfeiting the trade that we finally got on track is a fiasco.

japanese: 未成年者の喫煙は法律で禁じられている。
romaji: miseinensha no kitsuen wa houritsu de kinji rareteiru.
meaning: Minors are prohibited from smoking by law.

japanese: 国の経済だって、家庭の経済だって、個人の経済だって、丼勘定でいいものではない。
romaji: kuni no keizai datte, katei no keizai datte, kojin no keizai datte, donburikanjou deiimonodehanai.
meaning: Whether it's national economics, family economics, or personal economics, it's not something where sloppy accounting is good enough.

japanese: 政府は工業の振興計画を開始した。
romaji: seifu wa kougyou no shinkoukeikaku o kaishi shita.
meaning: The government started a program to promote industry.

japanese: 職員の選考に関する規則を次のように定める。
romaji: shokuin no senkou ni kansu ru kisoku o tsugino youni sadame ru.
meaning: Rules in connection with staff selection are set as follows.

japanese: 彼らは、産業を勉強します。
romaji: karera ha, sangyou o benkyou shimasu.
meaning: They study industry.

japanese: 値段が高すぎる！
romaji: nedan ga takasu giru!
meaning: It's too expensive!

japanese: 余りにも多くの人が政治に無関心である。
romaji: amari nimo ooku no nin ga seiji ni mukanshin dearu.
meaning: Too many people are indifferent to politics.

japanese: 日本人はこの百年間、西洋の考え方、感じ方を学びとろうとしてきた。
romaji: nihonjin hakono hyakunenkan, seiyou no kangaekata, kanjikata o manabi toroutoshitekita.
meaning: The Japanese have tried to learn the Western way of thinking and feeling for the past hundred years.

japanese: １００万人の人々がその戦争で命を落とした。
romaji: 1 0 0 bannin no hitobito gasono sensou de inochi o oto shita.
meaning: One million people lost their lives in the war.

japanese: 国際レベルの運動選手になるためには、毎日練習しなければならない。
romaji: kokusai reberu no undousenshu ninarutameniha, mainichirenshuu shinakerebanaranai.
meaning: One must practice every day in order to become a world-class athlete.

japanese: 隣の芝生はうちのより青い。
romaji: tonari no shibafu hauchinoyori aoi.
meaning: The grass is always greener on the other side of the fence.

japanese: 赤いドレスの女は、黒服の男を無視して、ケイタイで友達にかけた。
romaji: akai doresu no onna ha, kurofuku no otoko o mushishi te, keitai de tomodachi nikaketa.
meaning: The woman in a red dress ignored the black-clothed man and called a friend on her mobile.

japanese: どこをどう考えたら、俺がロボット工学に明るいなどと思うんだろうか。
romaji: dokowodou kangae tara, ore ga robotto kougaku ni akarui nadoto omou ndarouka.
meaning: Where did you come up with the idea that I'm familiar with robotics and such I wonder?

japanese: 彼女は健康のためにもっと温かいところへ引っ越した。
romaji: kanojo wa kenkou notamenimotto atatakai tokorohe hikkoshi ta.
meaning: She moved to a warmer place for the sake of her health.

japanese: あなたは新しいことを勉強したいのだと思った。
romaji: anataha atarashii kotowo benkyou shitainodato omotta.
meaning: I thought you liked to learn new things.

japanese: 今日はとても暑い。
romaji: konnichiha totemo atsui.
meaning: It is very hot today.

japanese: 片方の本は薄く、他方は厚い。
romaji: katahou no hon wa usuku, tahou wa atsui.
meaning: One book is thin, and the other is thick.

japanese: 私の命が危ないと言ってるわけですか？
romaji: watashi no inochi ga abunai to itte ruwakedesuka ？
meaning: Are you saying my life is in danger?

japanese: 歴史はどうしても伝統に甘いですからね。
romaji: rekishi hadoushitemo dentou ni amai desukarane.
meaning: History has never fared well against legend.

japanese: 何と言ったら良いか分かりません。
romaji: nantoitta ra yoi ka waka rimasen.
meaning: I'm at a loss for words.

japanese: 明日の準備で忙しい。
romaji: ashita no junbi de isogashii.
meaning: I'm busy getting ready for tomorrow.

japanese: 痛い！由紀子！痛いよ。グーで殴るのはよせよ！
romaji: itai! yukiko! itai yo. guu de naguru nohayoseyo!
meaning: Ow! Yukiko! That hurts! Quit hitting me with your fists!

japanese: 氷は非常に薄いので君の体重を支えきれないだろう。
romaji: koori wa hijouniusui node kun no taijuu o sasae kirenaidarou.
meaning: The ice is so thin that it won't bear your weight.

japanese: お兄ちゃん、このお魚本当に美味しいの？黒鯛が極道に落ちて、全国指名手配されたみたいなお魚だよ？
romaji: o niichan, konoo uomototou ni oishii no ？ kurodai ga gokudou ni ochi te, zenkokushimeitehai saretamitainao sakana dayo ？
meaning: Hey, is this fish tasty for real? It looks like a black porgy who'd fallen in with mobsters and been put on the country's most wanted list!?

japanese: この公園の西側に近いところは、道路の騒音も大きいが、奥にはいるともう聞こえない。
romaji: kono kouen no nishigawa ni chikai tokoroha, douro no souon mo ookii ga, oku nihairutomou kiko enai.
meaning: Near the west side of the park there's a lot of noise from the road, but when you go into the park you can't hear it any more.

japanese: 「少しうちに寄っていかない？」「いいの？」「うち共働きで親は遅いの」
romaji: ( sukoshi uchini yotsu teikanai ？) ( iino ？) ( uchi tomobataraki de oya wa osoi no)
meaning: "Want to drop round my place?" "Can I?" "My parents come home late as they both work."

japanese: 私の娘は尻が重いので困る。
romaji: watashi no musume wa shiri ga omoi node komaru.
meaning: My daughter's slowness to take action is a pain.

japanese: それは面白い。
romaji: soreha omoshiroi.
meaning: That is intriguing.

japanese: 自分に「できそこない」のレッテルを貼って生きていくのは辛いことだ。
romaji: jibun ni ( dekisokonai) no retteru o hatsu te iki teikunoha tsurai kotoda.
meaning: It's hard to live with the knowledge that you are a failure.

japanese: 飛行船は空気より軽い。
romaji: hikousen wa kuuki yori karui.
meaning: An airship is lighter than air.

japanese: 運命の赤い糸でつながってるんだよ。
romaji: unmei no akaiito detsunagatterundayo.
meaning: We're joined by the red string of fate!

japanese: 「転がる石は苔をもつけず」はことわざである。
romaji: ( koroga ru ishi wa koke womotsukezu) hakotowazadearu.
meaning: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.

japanese: 早朝の受付でクジを引いて順番を決めた。
romaji: souchou no uketsuke de kuji o hii te junban o kime ta.
meaning: We drew lots to decide who would go first at the early morning reception desk.

japanese: 「どうしたの？」「あのね、植木の枝の剪定をして欲しかったのよ」
romaji: ( doushitano ？) ( anone, ueki no eda no sentei woshite hosshi kattanoyo)
meaning: "What is it?" "Well, you see, I wanted the shrubs pruned."

japanese: 彼女は屋上でよくヴァイオリンの練習をしていたものだ。
romaji: kanojo wa okujou deyoku vaiorin no renshuu woshiteitamonoda.
meaning: She would often practice the violin on the roof.

japanese: 彼の誕生日に贈り物をあげたいんです。
romaji: kanotanjoubi ni okurimono woagetaindesu.
meaning: I would like to give him a present for his birthday.

japanese: 彼女が押し入れの中を覗き込んだ時、彼がドアを閉め、彼女を真っ暗な押し入れに閉じ込めてしまったのでした。
romaji: kanojo ga oshiire no naka o nozokikon da toki, kare ga doa o shime, kanojo o makkura na oshiire ni tojikome teshimattanodeshita.
meaning: When she looked, he shut the door and locked her into the totally dark closet.

japanese: 波風を鎮めるにはチーズケーキのお土産が良いらしいですよ。
romaji: namikaze o tsutsushime runiha chiizukeeki noo miyage ga yoi rashiidesuyo.
meaning: A gift of cheesecake is apparently good to soothe discord.

japanese: 彼女はプラスチックの玩具のバットで大きな蛇をたたき出した。
romaji: kanojo wa purasuchikku no gangu no batto de ooki na hebi wotataki dashi ta.
meaning: She beat off a big snake with a plastic toy bat.

japanese: 友人からもらったコンパクトの鏡の部分が割れてしまいました。
romaji: yuujin karamoratta konpakuto no kagami no bubun ga ware teshimaimashita.
meaning: The mirror on a compact I got from a friend has cracked.

japanese: 整えられた長机、いくつかのパイプ椅子、壁の掲示板にはカレンダーとプリント数枚が張られている。
romaji: totonoe rareta nagazukue, ikutsukano paipu isu, kabe no keijiban niha karendaa to purinto suumai ga hara reteiru.
meaning: There were long desks lined up, several pipe chairs, and stuck on the bulletin board were a calendar and several printouts.

japanese: 枠が出来上がると、クモはちょうど自転車の車輪のやのように、それに絹の糸をかける。
romaji: waku ga dekiaga ruto, kumo hachoudo jitensha no sharin noyanoyouni, soreni kinu no ito wokakeru.
meaning: When the frame is finished, the spider fixes lines of silk across it, just like the spokes of a bicycle wheel.

japanese: 雨が降って土に湿り気があると草は取りやすくなる。
romaji: ame ga futsu te tsuchi ni shimerikiga aruto kusa wa tori yasukunaru.
meaning: When rain's fallen and the soil is moist, it becomes easier to pull out weeds.

japanese: 夕方になって少し雲が出てきました。
romaji: yuugata ninatte sukoshikumo ga dete kimashita.
meaning: By evening, a few clouds had formed.

japanese: 消しゴムを借りてもいい？
romaji: keshigomu o kari temoii ？
meaning: May I borrow your eraser?

japanese: 林に竹が目立つ。
romaji: hayashi ni take ga medatsu.
meaning: Bamboo stands out in the woods.

japanese: 猟犬が森のほうにいった。
romaji: ryouken ga mori nohouniitta.
meaning: The hunting dog headed for the woods.

japanese: 「彼女は音楽が好きだ」「私もそうだ」
romaji: ( kanojo wa ongaku ga suki da) ( watashi mosouda)
meaning: "She likes music." "So do I."

japanese: マリア・カラスは有名なオペラ歌手でした。
romaji: maria・karasu wa yuumei na opera kashu deshita.
meaning: Maria Callas was a famous opera singer.

japanese: 「おしっこしたい」「ジョニー、そうじゃないだろ。『すみません。お手洗いにいきたいんですが』と言いなさい」
romaji: ( oshikkoshitai) ( jonii, soujanaidaro. ( sumimasen. o tearai niikitaindesuga) to ii nasai)
meaning: "I have to pee." "Jonny, that's not the right thing to say. Say, 'Excuse me. I need to go to the toilet.'"

japanese: もう電話を切らなくてはなりません。電話が空くのを待っている人がいるのです。
romaji: mou denwa o kira nakutehanarimasen. denwa ga aku nowo matsu teiru nin gairunodesu.
meaning: I've got to hang up now. Someone is waiting to use the phone.

japanese: 彼は二者択一を選ぶことでしょう。武術か死か。
romaji: karehanishatakuitsu o erabu kotodeshou. bujutsu ka shi ka.
meaning: Which will he choose, I wonder, martial arts or death?

japanese: 母が私を強く抱きしめたのを思い出す。
romaji: haha ga watashi o tsuyokudaki shimetanowo omoidasu.
meaning: Recollect my mother holding me tight.

japanese: 世界を変えるのは情報ではなくコミュニケーションだ。
romaji: sekai o kae runoha jouhou dehanaku komyunikeeshon da.
meaning: What changes the world is communication, not information.

japanese: ノートパソコンの電源を入れ、ブラウザを立ち上げて、もう覚えてしまったアドレスを打ち込む。
romaji: nootopasokon no dengen o ire, burauza o tachiage te, mou oboe teshimatta adoresu o uchikomu.
meaning: I switch on my laptop, start up the browser, and type in the address I've already learnt by heart.

japanese: 彼らは敵の上に天罰が下ることを祈った。
romaji: karera wa teki no uenitenbatsu ga kudaru kotowo inotsu ta.
meaning: They called down the wrath of God upon the heads of their enemies.

japanese: 彼は立ち上るように言われ、ゆっくりとそうした。
romaji: karehatachinoboru youni iwa re, yukkuritosoushita.
meaning: He was told to stand up, and he did so slowly.

japanese: 列車は滑るように駅からでていった。
romaji: ressha wa suberu youni eki karadeteitta.
meaning: The train rolled out of the station.

japanese: 人生とは、他の予定を立てることに忙しくしている時に起こる現象のことだ。
romaji: jinsei toha, hokanoyotei o tate rukotoni isogashiku shiteiru tokinioko ru genshou nokotoda.
meaning: Life is what happens to you while you're busy making other plans.

japanese: 父は壁を建てるのに忙しい。
romaji: chichi wa kabe o tate runoni isogashii.
meaning: Father is busy putting up a wall.

japanese: 夜はこのホテルに泊まるつもりです。
romaji: yoru hakono hoteru ni toma rutsumoridesu.
meaning: I'm going to stop at this hotel for the night.

japanese: 父にとって酒を止めるのは難しい。
romaji: chichi nitotte sake o yameru noha muzukashii.
meaning: It's hard for my father to give up drinking.

japanese: 風邪を人に移すと治るって本当？
romaji: kaze o nin ni utsusu to naoru tte hontou ？
meaning: Is it true that you recover from colds when you give them to someone else?

japanese: 夫が亡くなると彼女には赤ん坊が何より大切になった。
romaji: otto ga naku naruto kanojo niha akanbou ga nani yori taisetsu ninatta.
meaning: After her husband died, her baby was all in all to her.

japanese: 私がここの生活に慣れるのに時間がかかりそうです。
romaji: watashi gakokono seikatsu ni nare runoni jikan gakakarisoudesu.
meaning: It seems like it will take me a while to get accustomed to life here.

japanese: 僕は田舎で育った。
romaji: bokuhainaka de sodatsu ta.
meaning: I grew up in the country.

japanese: プレステ２発売後、ゲームソフト売り場は百花撩乱状態だ。
romaji: puresute 2 hatsubaigo, geemusofuto uriba wa hyakkaryouranjoutai da.
meaning: Since the release of the PlayStation 2, game store shelves have blossomed with a variety of new titles.

japanese: 「ついお宅のバラに見とれてしまってまして。本当に華やかですこと」「まあ、お上手ねえ。それはどうも」
romaji: ( tsuio taku no bara ni mito reteshimattemashite. hontou ni hanaya kadesukoto) ( maa, o jouzu nee. sorehadoumo)
meaning: "I was just admiring your roses. They're absolutely gorgeous." "Oh, I'm flattered. Thank you."

japanese: これはお祭り;祭り。
romaji: kore wa omatsuri.
meaning: This is festival.

japanese: 私は海の近くに住んでいるのでよく海岸に行きます。
romaji: watashi wa umi no chikaku ni sun deirunodeyoku kaigan ni iki masu.
meaning: I live near the sea, so I often get to go to the beach.

japanese: 彼女はしっかりした視線で私を見て、会議室をでた。
romaji: kanojo hashikkarishita shisen de watashi o mite, kaigishitsu wodeta.
meaning: She looked at me in a deliberate way and left the meeting room.

japanese: 会場に着くと早速担当者に「この絵は将来必ず値が上がる」などとしつこく言われ、契約書にサインしてしまった。
romaji: kaijou ni tsuku to sassokutantousha ni ( kono e wa shouraikanarazuatai ga aga ru) nadotoshitsukoku iwa re, keiyakusho ni sain shiteshimatta.
meaning: When I reached the hall right away the person in charge unrelentingly said things like "This painting is certain to increase in value in the future," and I went and signed the contract.

japanese: 老人に教会の場所を聞かれて、私はそれを指し示した。
romaji: roujin ni kyoukai no basho o kika rete, watashi hasorewo sashishimeshi ta.
meaning: When I was asked by an old man where the church was, I pointed it out.

japanese: こっちにきてから、ずっと近所でビバークしてたの？大変だったね。
romaji: kotchinikitekara, zutto kinjo de bibaaku shitetano ？ taihen dattane.
meaning: You've been camping out ever since you came over here? Must have been terrible.

japanese: この空港は新千歳空港ほど便数が多くないので、送迎デッキから見ても最初は飛行機がいませんでした。
romaji: kono kuukou wa shinchitosekuukou hodo binsuu ga ooku nainode, sougei dekki kara mite mo saisho wa hikouki gaimasendeshita.
meaning: This airport doesn't have as many flights as New Chitose Airport and even looking from the observation deck at first there were no planes.

japanese: 彼女は学生を下宿させて収入をえている。
romaji: kanojo wa gakusei o geshuku sasete shuunyuu woeteiru.
meaning: She earns money by taking in students.

japanese: 暴力犯罪は郊外にも広がった。
romaji: bouryokuhanzai wa kougai nimo hiroga tta.
meaning: Violent crime spread into the suburbs.

japanese: 郵便局に住所の変更を通知するつもりだ。
romaji: yuubinkyoku ni juusho no henkou o tsuuchi surutsumorida.
meaning: I am going to inform the post office of the change of my address.

japanese: 遅れて到着した学生は講堂に入れません。
romaji: okure te touchaku shita gakusei wa koudou ni ire masen.
meaning: Students arriving late will not be permitted to enter the hall.

japanese: 坂を下りるときに彼女のおんぼろ自転車はキーキー音を立てた。
romaji: saka o oriru tokini kanojo noonboro jitensha wa kiikii oto o tate ta.
meaning: Her old bike squeaked as she rode down the hill.

japanese: ハバロフスク市が極東ロシアで大都会の一つです。
romaji: habarofusuku shi ga kyokutou roshia de daitokai no hitotsu desu.
meaning: Khabarovsk is among the largest cities of the Russian Far East.

japanese: 有意義な回答とは、新たな疑問を生むようなそれである。
romaji: yuuigi na kaitou toha, arata na gimon o umu younasoredearu.
meaning: The only useful answers are those that raise new questions.

japanese: たまには偏差値の高い人とレベルの高い会話してみたい。
romaji: tamaniha hensachi no takainin to reberu no takaikaiwa shitemitai.
meaning: I like to have a deep conversation with a more academic person from time to time.

japanese: 彼は大体あなたぐらいの年齢です。
romaji: karehadaitai anataguraino nenrei desu.
meaning: He is about your age.

japanese: ※基本的な禁止事項（誹謗・中傷の禁止等）は「はじめにお読み下さい」に記載してあります。必ずお読みください。
romaji: ※ kihonteki na kinshijikou ( hibou ・ chuushou no kinshinado) wa ( hajimenio yomikudasai) ni kisaishi tearimasu. kanarazu o yomi kudasai.
meaning: * The basic prohibitions (No slander, libel, etc.) are noted in the "Read me first." Please be sure to read it.

japanese: 「高い所って、あたしは好きだなぁ。あたしって、前世はきっと・・・飛行機だったのかな？」「普通、そこは鳥でしょうが」
romaji: ( takaitokoro tte, atashiha suki danaa. atashitte, zense hakitto ・・・ hikouki dattanokana ？) ( futsuu, sokoha tori deshouga)
meaning: "I rather like heights. You know, in my last life I must have been ... an aeroplane?" "Usually that would be 'bird' there."

japanese: ９０歳以上生きることは決してまれではない。
romaji: 9 0 toshiijouiki rukotoha kesshite maredehanai.
meaning: It is not rare at all to live over ninety years.

japanese: 飼鳥の医学―病気の診断とその治療。
romaji: kaidori no igakuubyouki no shindan tosono chiryou.
meaning: Avian medicine - diagnosis and treatment of illnesses.

japanese: 旅行に行く前に注射をしなければならない。
romaji: ryokou ni ikumae ni chuusha woshinakerebanaranai.
meaning: I need some shots before I go on my trip.

japanese: 洗ったあと引っ張って形にして。
romaji: aratsu taato hippatsu te katachi nishite.
meaning: Pull into shape after washing.

japanese: 「あの音で考え事ができないわ」と、彼女はタイプライターを見つめながら言った。
romaji: ( ano oto de kangaekoto gadekinaiwa) to, kanojo wa taipuraitaa o mitsu menagara itta.
meaning: "I can't think with that noise," she said, as she stared at the typewriter.

japanese: 普通科目の他に機械についての基礎的な事柄を学習し、各種の機械の使用法や技術を身につける実習などを行います。
romaji: futsuukamenohokanikikai nitsuiteno kisoteki na kotogara o gakushuu shi, kakushu no kikai no shiyouhou ya gijutsu o mini tsukeru jisshuu nadowo okonai masu.
meaning: In addition to the general curriculum there are tutorials in the essentials of machinery, training is also carried out for skills in and learning how to use the various types of machinery.

japanese: ストレスが胃の粘膜を荒らす原因のひとつは次のように考えられています。
romaji: sutoresu ga i no nenmaku o arasugen'in nohitotsuha tsugino youni kangae rareteimasu.
meaning: The following is thought to be one of the reasons stress damages the stomach's mucous membrane.

japanese: 学校教育の義務的側面は子どもの学習意欲を改善させる様々な研究の多くの取り組みの中ではめったに分析されない。
romaji: gakkoukyouiku no gimutekisokumen wa kodomo no gakushuuiyoku o kaizen saseru samazamanakenkyuu no ooku no torikumi no naka dehamettani bunseki sarenai.
meaning: The mandatory character of schooling is rarely analyzed in the multitude of works dedicated to the study of the various ways to develop within children the desire to learn.

japanese: いつまでかかっても全部を説明するのは無理だ。
romaji: itsumadekakattemo zenbu o setsumeisu runoha muri da.
meaning: It would take forever for me to explain everything.

japanese: リトマス紙で溶液の液性（酸性、中性、塩基性）を調べるときは、リトマス紙をすべて溶液に浸すのではなく、紙の先端の部分だけを浸します。
romaji: ritomasu kami de youeki no ekisei ( sansei, chuusei, enkisei) o shirabe rutokiha, ritomasu kami wosubete youeki ni hitasu nodehanaku, kami no sentan no bubun dakewo hitashi masu.
meaning: When investigating the pH (acidic, neutral, alkaline) of a liquid, don't soak the litmus paper completely in the liquid but just put the end of the paper in it.

japanese: 「具合はどうなんですか？」「ああ、うん・・・少し脱水症状が出ているかな」
romaji: ( guai hadounandesuka ？) ( aa, un ・・・ sukoshidassuishoujou ga dete irukana)
meaning: "How is it?" "Well, yes ... could be some signs of dehydration."

japanese: 彼女のお見舞いに行こうよ。
romaji: kanojo noo mimai ni iko uyo.
meaning: Why don't we go and see her in the hospital?

japanese: ４．中華鍋にごま油を熱してバターを溶かす。
romaji: 4. chuukanabe nigoma abura o atsushi te bataa o toka su.
meaning: 4. Heat the sesame oil in the wok and melt the butter.

japanese: 両親のどちらかがその会議に行かねばならない。
romaji: ryoushin nodochirakagasono kaigi ni ika nebanaranai.
meaning: Either of my parents must go to the meeting.

japanese: 「はい」と「いいえ」しか言わない人と会話を続けるのは難しい。
romaji: ( hai) to ( iie) shika iwa nai nin to kaiwa o tsuzuke runoha muzukashii.
meaning: It is difficult to keep up a conversation with someone who only says "yes" and "no".

japanese: 母ちゃんも同じ事いってたな。だからどうしたってんだよ。オレにゃ関係ない。
romaji: kaachan mo onajikoto ittetana. dakaradoushitattendayo. ore nya kankei nai.
meaning: Mum said the same thing. But, so what? It's got nothing to do with me.

japanese: それで彼らの気が変わったのかも知れない。
romaji: sorede karera no kigakawa ttanokamo shire nai.
meaning: That was probably what influenced their decision.

japanese: なかなか「きもの」を着る機会がないというかたも、思い切って着てみましょう！
romaji: nakanaka ( kimono) o kirukikai ganaitoiukatamo, omoikitsu te kite mimashou!
meaning: Also, those of you who don't have the chance to wear a 'kimono', go for it and wear one!

japanese: 例えば、たばこをぷかぷか吸う先生が、たばこを吸う生徒に注意してもその注意は矛盾しているだろう。
romaji: tatoeba, tabakowopukapuka suusensei ga, tabakowo suuseito ni chuui shitemosono chuui wa mujun shiteirudarou.
meaning: For example, if a chain-smoking teacher cautions a pupil for smoking, that warning is self-contradictory.

japanese: この赤ちゃんペンギンとっても可愛い！
romaji: kono akachan pengin tottemo kawai!
meaning: This baby penguin is too cute!

japanese: 厳しいトレーニングに、彼は音を上げた。
romaji: ikameshii toreeningu ni, karehaoto o age ta.
meaning: He gave up under the severe training he faced.

japanese: 彼は黄色いあの家に住んでいる。
romaji: karehakiiroi ano ie ni sun deiru.
meaning: He lives in that yellow house.

japanese: 彼らは決して汚いプレーをしてはならない。
romaji: karera wa kesshitekitanai puree woshitehanaranai.
meaning: They should never play foul.

japanese: 俺は締め出されてるんだぞ？後ろ暗いことがあるに決まってる。
romaji: ore wa shimedasa reterundazo ？ ushirogurai kotogaaruni kima tteru.
meaning: I was locked out! There's got to be something fishy going on.

japanese: 彼女は色が黒い。
romaji: kanojo wa iro ga kuroi.
meaning: She is dark-skinned.

japanese: 殿方が細かいことにこだわるものではありません。
romaji: tonogata ga komakai kotonikodawarumonodehaarimasen.
meaning: It doesn't become a gentleman to fuss over trifles.

japanese: 女として自覚なさ過ぎて怖い。
romaji: onna toshite jikaku nasa sugi te kowai.
meaning: It's scary how little consideration she gives to being a woman.

japanese: 彼女は一人だが、寂しいとは思うことはなかった。
romaji: kanojo wa hitori daga, sabishii toha omou kotohanakatta.
meaning: Though she was alone, I didn't think she was lonely.

japanese: 寒い。
romaji: samui.
meaning: It's cold.

japanese: 「どうかしたの？」と小さな白いウサギが聞きました。
romaji: ( doukashitano ？) to chiisa na shiroi usagi ga kiki mashita.
meaning: "What's the matter?" asked the little white rabbit.

japanese: 日の下にいるより日陰に立っているほうが涼しい。
romaji: nichi no shitani iruyori hikage ni tatsu teiruhouga suzushii.
meaning: I feel cooler standing in the shade, rather than out in the sun.

japanese: 従姉妹にはね、もの凄いボインボインな子がいるんだよ？
romaji: itoko nihane, mono sugoi boinboin na ko gairundayo ？
meaning: Among my cousins, you know, there's a girl with the most enormous breasts.

japanese: 美しいものが与えてくれる感動は素晴らしいものだったが、私にはその感動を保持する事も、いつまでも繰り返す事もできなかった。世界で最も美しいものでさえも、最後には私を退屈させてしまったのである。
romaji: utsukushii monoga atae tekureru kandou wa subarashii monodattaga, watashi nihasono kandou o hoji suru koto mo, itsumademo kurikaesukoto modekinakatta. sekai de mottomoutsukushii monodesaemo, saigo niha watashi o taikutsu saseteshimattanodearu.
meaning: The emotion they gave me was exquisite, but I could not preserve it, nor could I indefinitely repeat it; the most beautiful things in the world finished by boring me.

japanese: 彼女はその狭いドライブウェイを何とかバックで通り抜けた。
romaji: kanojo hasono semai doraibuuei o nantoka bakku de tourinuke ta.
meaning: She managed to back up through the narrow driveway.

japanese: あなたは正しい。
romaji: anataha tadashii.
meaning: You're right.

japanese: 欲しいものがみつかると、決まって高いものだ。
romaji: hoshii monogamitsukaruto, kima tte takai monoda.
meaning: Whenever I find something I like, it's too expensive.

japanese: こーゆーのは、買うのが楽しいのよ。使うか使わないかなんてのは、二の次なんだって。
romaji: kooyuunoha, kau noga tanoshii noyo. tsukau ka tsukawa naikanantenoha, ninotsugi nandatte.
meaning: This sort of thing, it's buying stuff that's fun. Whether you use it or not is secondary.

japanese: ４月に孵化した雛も５ヶ月になった。身体の大きさは親鳥とほぼ同じ、オス鳥のとさかが少し小さいぐらいか。
romaji: 4 gatsu ni fuka shita hina mo 5 ke gatsu ninatta. shintai no ookisa wa oyadori tohobo onaji, osu tori notosakaga sukoshichiisai guraika.
meaning: The chicks hatched in April have also become 5 months old. Their bodies are about the same size as their parents, about the only difference is that the roosters have smaller crests than their father.

japanese: この公園の西側に近いところは、道路の騒音も大きいが、奥にはいるともう聞こえない。
romaji: kono kouen no nishigawa ni chikai tokoroha, douro no souon mo ookii ga, oku nihairutomou kiko enai.
meaning: Near the west side of the park there's a lot of noise from the road, but when you go into the park you can't hear it any more.

japanese: 庶民のなりわいは、米をつくることだった。
romaji: shomin nonariwaiha, kome wotsukurukotodatta.
meaning: The ordinary people had their livelihood in farming rice.

japanese: 私はいつも辞典を３冊手元に置いています。
romaji: watashi haitsumo jiten o 3 satsutemoto ni oi teimasu.
meaning: I always keep three dictionaries at hand.

japanese: 返品した品物の代金を私の口座に振り込んで下さい。
romaji: henpin shita shinamono no daikin o watashi no kouza ni furikon de kudasai.
meaning: Please credit my account for the returned item.

japanese: ある人物が不変の性質で全人生を貫くということは小説の中だけの話だ。
romaji: aru jinbutsu ga fuhen no seishitsu de zenjinnama o tsuranuku toiukotoha shousetsu no naka dakeno hanashi da.
meaning: Only in novels do you find individuals who live out their whole life with unvarying character.

japanese: 彼らはすぐに買っておいた食料品を使い果たしてしまった。
romaji: karera hasuguni katsu teoita shokuryouhin o tsukaihata shiteshimatta.
meaning: They soon used up their food supplies.

japanese: 水から上がり、入江のほとりの砂の上を、よちよち歩き出しました。
romaji: mizu kara aga ri, irie nohotorino suna no ue wo, yochiyochi arukidashi mashita.
meaning: She pulled herself out of the water and waddled along the sand at the edge of the creek.

japanese: ６月末に参加者を募ったら１週間弱で約５００席が予約でいっぱいになった。
romaji: 6 getsumatsu ni sankasha o tsunotsu tara 1 shuukanjaku de yaku 5 0 0 seki ga yoyaku deippaininatta.
meaning: When participants were sought at the end of June all, about 500, seats were reserved in under a week.

japanese: 彼女はハンカチをきちんと畳んだ。
romaji: kanojo wa hankachi wokichinto tatami nda.
meaning: She folded her handkerchief neatly.

japanese: ワタシは背が低いので棚の上まで見られないのでほぼ手探りで拭くわけです。
romaji: watashi wa segahikui node tana no ue made mira renainodehobo tesaguri de fuku wakedesu.
meaning: I'm short, so I can't see on top of the shelves and so I pretty much dust by touch.

japanese: 下手の横好きで撮影している写真を日記とともに紹介しています。
romaji: heta no yokosuki de satsuei shiteiru shashin o nikki totomoni shoukai shiteimasu.
meaning: I'm introducing some pictures I took, dabbling in photography, along with my diary.

japanese: まあまあなんて細い腰なの！お顔も小さくて、本当にお人形さんみたい！
romaji: maamaanante komaikoshi nano! o kao mo chiisaku te, hontou nio ningyou sanmitai!
meaning: My what a narrow waist! Her face is small, she really looks just like a doll!

japanese: 露が草の葉におりている。
romaji: tsuyu ga kusa no wa nioriteiru.
meaning: The dew is on the leaves of grass.

japanese: 布団をはがされた。
romaji: futon wohagasareta.
meaning: My futon was peeled away.

japanese: 七夕は漫画によく出てくるので、私もそこそこ知っています。
romaji: tanabata wa manga niyoku dete kurunode, watashi mosokosoko shitte imasu.
meaning: Tanabata comes up in manga a lot so I also know it fairly well.

japanese: 木綿のミットをつければ赤ちゃんは自分の顔をひっかかなくなる。
romaji: momen no mitto wotsukereba akachan wa jibun no kao wohikkakanakunaru.
meaning: Cotton mittens will prevent the baby from scratching his own face.

japanese: あなたは私が出発してから到着した。
romaji: anataha watashi ga shuppatsu shitekara touchaku shita.
meaning: You arrived at the moment I left.

japanese: 僕の上着は君のと仕立て方が違う。
romaji: boku no uwagi wa kun noto shitatehougachigau.
meaning: My jacket is made differently from yours.

japanese: 君の不首尾は承知している。
romaji: kun no fushubi wa shouchi shiteiru.
meaning: I'm aware that you failed.

japanese: 嵐の後すぐ、そのラジオ局は放送を再開した。
romaji: arashi no nochi sugu, sono rajio kyoku wa housou o saikai shita.
meaning: The radio station came back on the air shortly after the storm.

japanese: 竹内だけは招待に応じなかった。
romaji: takeuchi dakeha shoutai ni ouji nakatta.
meaning: Only Takeuchi didn't accept the invitation.

japanese: 速く儲けた金は速く無くなる。
romaji: hayakumouke ta kin wa hayakunaku naru.
meaning: Soon gotten soon spent.

japanese: 彼は決して金を盗むような人ではない。
romaji: karehakesshitekin o nusumu youna nin dehanai.
meaning: He would be the last man to steal money.

japanese: 労働者階級には敬意を払うべきである。
romaji: roudoushakaikyuu niha keii o harau bekidearu.
meaning: Respect is due to the proletariat.

japanese: もっと運動をしないと太るよ。
romaji: motto undou woshinaito futoru yo.
meaning: If you don't get more exercise, you'll get fat.

japanese: 食べすぎさえしなければ、必ず痩せると思います。
romaji: tabe sugisaeshinakereba, kanarazuyase ruto omoi masu.
meaning: I think that as long as I don't overeat, I will certainly lose weight.

japanese: 頭が割れるように痛かったので、私はいつもより早く寝た。
romaji: atama ga ware ruyouni itaka ttanode, watashi haitsumoyori hayakuneta.
meaning: Having a splitting headache, I went to bed earlier than usual.

japanese: 宇宙でどうやって食べ物をみつけるの？
romaji: uchuu dedouyatte tabemono womitsukeruno ？
meaning: How do you find food in outer space?

japanese: 明日の朝起きたら、素敵なものが見つかるよ。
romaji: ashita no asaoki tara, suteki namonoga mitsu karuyo.
meaning: When you wake up tomorrow morning, you will find a wonderful thing.

japanese: 問題はいかにして資金を集めるかである。
romaji: mondai haikanishite shikin o atsume rukadearu.
meaning: The problem is how to raise the funds.

japanese: 朝は洗顔はもちろん身だしなみを整えてからここに集まるんだ。
romaji: asa wa sengan hamochiron midashinami o totonoe tekarakokoni atsumaru nda.
meaning: Obviously wash your face, but you must also take care of your appearance before assembling here.

japanese: 悲しみに暮れるその女性は友人たちに慰められた。
romaji: kanashimi ni kure rusono josei wa yuujin tachini nagusame rareta.
meaning: The grieving woman was consoled by her friends.

japanese: 彼らの気に触ることは何もしてないのに、彼らは私のことを悪く思っている。
romaji: karera no kinifuru kotoha nanimo shitenainoni, karera wa watashi nokotowo warukuomotte iru.
meaning: Though I have done nothing against them, they think ill of me.

japanese: 明日彼を訪ねるつもりだ。
romaji: ashitakare o tazune rutsumorida.
meaning: I'll call on him tomorrow.

japanese: でもあいにくの雨で試合は中止になった。
romaji: demoainikuno ame de shiai wa chuushi ninatta.
meaning: But, unfortunately, the game was called off due to rain.

japanese: ニューギニア島には、大型の肉食獣がいなかったためです。
romaji: nyuuginia shima niha, oogata no nikushokukemono gainakattatamedesu.
meaning: That's because there weren't any large carnivores in New Guinea.

japanese: 私がいなかったら、この事務所は３日でカオスですよ。
romaji: watashi gainakattara, kono jimusho wa 3 nichi de kaosu desuyo.
meaning: If I wasn't here, this office would be in chaos in three days.

japanese: 初詣、ご利益があるのはどこの神社？
romaji: hatsumoude, go rieki gaarunohadokono jinja ？
meaning: New Year shrine visit; which shrines are potent?

japanese: 戦場に赴くカメラマンが不発弾の危険性を知らないのは不思議だ、新聞社は教育を怠ってる。
romaji: senjou ni omomuku kameraman ga fuhatsudan no kikensei o shira nainoha fushigi da, shinbunsha wa kyouiku o okotatsu teru.
meaning: It is strange that a cameraman heading for a war-zone should not know about the danger of unexploded shells. The newspaper company is being negligent in its training.

japanese: この世界の教育にはがっかりしてしまう。
romaji: kono sekai no kyouiku nihagakkarishiteshimau.
meaning: Education in this world disappoints me.

japanese: 彼は中学校に入った。
romaji: karehachuugakkou ni itsutsu ta.
meaning: He entered junior high school.

japanese: 彼はあの駐車場で車を盗まれた。
romaji: kareha ano chuushajou de kuruma o nusuma reta.
meaning: He had his car stolen in that parking lot.

japanese: 彼は先週そのお寺をたずねるつもりだった。
romaji: karehasenshuu sonoo tera wotazunerutsumoridatta.
meaning: He intended to have visited the temple last week.

japanese: 彼は銀の木がある黄金の都についてすばらしい話を聞いたことがあった。
romaji: karehagin no ki gaaru ougon no miyako nitsuitesubarashii hanashi o kii takotogaatta.
meaning: He had heard wonderful stories about cities of gold with silver trees.

japanese: 僕は動物園へ行くのを楽しみに待っているんだ。
romaji: bokuhadoubutsuen e iku nowo tanoshimi ni matsu teirunda.
meaning: I am looking forward to going to the zoo.

japanese: 彼はまずめったに床屋へ行かない。
romaji: kareha mazumettani tokoya e ika nai.
meaning: He seldom, if ever, goes to the barber's.

japanese: これは二階建て。
romaji: kore wa nikaidate.
meaning: This is two storied.

japanese: あなたは他の誰も見ていなかった場所で私を見つけた。
romaji: anataha hokanodaremomite inakatta basho de watashi o mitsu keta.
meaning: You found me where no one else was looking.

japanese: 林に竹が目立つ。
romaji: hayashi ni take ga medatsu.
meaning: Bamboo stands out in the woods.

japanese: 体を大事にしなさい。
romaji: karada o daiji nishinasai.
meaning: Take good care of yourself.

japanese: 彼女は大分に行く予定です。
romaji: kanojo wa ooita ni ikuyotei desu.
meaning: She's going to Ooita.

japanese: コートを探してます。背が低いので、丈は短めで、なるべくすっきりしたデザインのものを。
romaji: kooto o sagashi temasu. segahikui node, take wa mijikame de, narubekusukkirishita dezain nomonowo.
meaning: I'm looking for a coat. I'm short so the length should be on the short side, and as refined a design as possible.

japanese: それは確かに一案です。
romaji: soreha tashikaniichian desu.
meaning: That's certainly one possibility.

japanese: なお、危険防止の為、サブアド利用をお奨めします。
romaji: nao, kikenboushi no tame, sabuado riyou woo shou meshimasu.
meaning: Moreover, for your safety, we advise use of a substitute email address.

japanese: 教育産業に関する情報を掲載したインターネットサイトには以下のようなものがあります。
romaji: kyouikusangyou ni kansu ru jouhou o keisai shita intaanettosaito niha ikano younamonogaarimasu.
meaning: Among the Internet sites that publish information on education related businesses are those given below.

japanese: 申し訳ないけど長居できないんですよ。
romaji: moushiwakenai kedo nagai dekinaindesuyo.
meaning: I'm sorry, I can't stay long.

japanese: この世界の教育にはがっかりしてしまう。
romaji: kono sekai no kyouiku nihagakkarishiteshimau.
meaning: Education in this world disappoints me.

japanese: 彼女は講義に出席しなかった。
romaji: kanojo wa kougi ni shusseki shinakatta.
meaning: She was absent from lectures.

japanese: 予習を始めた方がいいですよ。
romaji: yoshuu o hajime ta houga iidesuyo.
meaning: You may as well begin to prepare your lessons.

japanese: 第５課を復習しましょう。
romaji: daigoka o fukushuu shimashou.
meaning: Let's review Lesson 5.

japanese: 物理学は物質、運動、エネルギーの科学であると定義することができる。
romaji: butsurigaku wa busshitsu, undou, enerugii no kagaku dearuto teigi surukotogadekiru.
meaning: Physics can be defined as the science of matter, motion, and energy.

japanese: 理論的には、私は数学をしている。
romaji: rironteki niha, watashi wa suugaku woshiteiru.
meaning: Theoretically, I'm doing math.

japanese: 君はなかなか地理に明るいな。
romaji: kun hanakanaka chiri ni akarui na.
meaning: You're pretty good with the lay of the land.

japanese: どうしてそんなに日本の歴史に詳しいの？
romaji: doushitesonnani nippon no rekishi ni kuwashii no ？
meaning: How come you know so much about Japanese history?

japanese: それを皮切りとして欧州の詩や文学を多数紹介するようになりました。
romaji: sorewo kawakiri ritoshite oushuu no shi ya bungaku o tasuushoukai suruyouninarimashita.
meaning: With that as a start many European poems and much literature came to be introduced.

japanese: この本は、現代日本語の文法をできるだけわかりやすく、体系的に説明しようとする本です。
romaji: kono hon ha, gendainihongo no bunpou wodekirudakewakariyasuku, taikeiteki ni setsumeishi youtosuru hon desu.
meaning: This book aims to provide an explanation of modern Japanese grammar that is as systematic and as easily understood as possible.

japanese: 少しの間だけでも一緒に戦ってくれるだけで御の字よ。
romaji: sukoshi no kan dakedemo isshonitatakatsu tekurerudakede o no ji yo.
meaning: Even if it's just for a short while fighting alongside us is all I could ask for.

japanese: 両地域は宗教と文化が違っている。
romaji: ryouchiiki wa shuukyou to bunka ga chigatsu teiru.
meaning: The two regions differ in religion and culture.

japanese: 試験が教育を駄目にしていると思う。
romaji: shiken ga kyouiku o dame nishiteiruto omou.
meaning: I think exams are ruining education.

japanese: 来年の春は卒業したいなあ。
romaji: rainen no haru wa sotsugyou shitainaa.
meaning: Next spring I want to graduate.

japanese: 明日３マイル競争が行われる予定です。
romaji: ashita 3 mairu kyousou ga okonawa reru yotei desu.
meaning: There's going to be a three-mile race tomorrow.

japanese: 黒魔法の話を聞きたいです。学院ではさわりしか聞いたことがないんですが興味があります。
romaji: kuromahou no hanashi o kiki taidesu. gakuin dehasawarishika kii takotoganaindesuga kyoumi gaarimasu.
meaning: I'd like to hear about black magic. I was only told the highlights in the academy, and it interests me.

japanese: 歴史上の名所を見物しました。
romaji: rekishijou no meisho o kenbutsu shimashita.
meaning: We visited places of historic interest.

japanese: 離れて見ると景色に魅力がつく。
romaji: hanare te miru to keshiki ni miryoku gatsuku.
meaning: Distance lends enchantment to the view.

japanese: 良い習慣は子供時代に養うべきである。
romaji: yoishuukan wa kodomojidai ni yashinau bekidearu.
meaning: Good habits should be cultivated in childhood.
