meaning: I sit down crosslegged where Aoi points.

japanese: 私の心は幸福感でいっぱいだった。
romaji: watashi no kokorohakoufukukan deippaidatta.
meaning: My heart was filled with happiness.

japanese: このビルのエレベーターってさ、よく故障するんだ。
romaji: kono biru no erebeetaa ttesa, yoku koshou surunda.
meaning: The elevators in this building are often out of order.

japanese: 彼女は卒業するまでたいへん内気だった。
romaji: kanojo wa sotsugyou surumadetaihen uchiki datta.
meaning: She had been very shy till she graduated.

japanese: 彼はときどき寝坊する。
romaji: kareha tokidoki nebou suru.
meaning: He sometimes sleeps in.

japanese: 最大限に首相という権力を利用し、自己の保身の為に利用するキツネのようにずる賢い首相に見えてくる。
romaji: saidaigen ni shushou toiu kenryoku o riyou shi, jiko no hoshin no tameniriyou suru kitsune noyounizuru kashikoishushou ni mie tekuru.
meaning: He has come to look like a sly-as-a-fox Premier who uses his position's powers to the fullest extent, to his own advantage.

japanese: 彼の手紙に返事するべきだろうか？
romaji: kanotegami ni henji surubekidarouka ？
meaning: I wonder if I should answer his letter.

japanese: 会えば必ず喧嘩する。
romaji: ae ba kanarazukenka suru.
meaning: Whenever they meet, they quarrel.

japanese: 彼は生活するのに十分な金を稼いでいない。
romaji: karehaseikatsu surunoni juubun na kin o kasei deinai.
meaning: He doesn't earn enough money to live on.

japanese: 同社は醤油その他の食品を生産する。
romaji: dousha wa shouyu sono hokanoshokuhin o seisan suru.
meaning: The company produces soy sauce and other food products.

japanese: 彼女はしまいには入院するはめになった。
romaji: kanojo hashimainiha nyuuin suruhameninatta.
meaning: She ended up in the hospital.

japanese: 両親は私がその大学に入学することを期待している。
romaji: ryoushin wa watashi gasono daigaku ni nyuugaku surukotowo kitaishi teiru.
meaning: My parents expect me to enter the university.

japanese: 彼女はまもなく退院するでしょう。
romaji: kanojo hamamonaku taiin surudeshou.
meaning: She will leave the hospital soon.

japanese: 証拠隠滅どーすんのよ！普通は警察に連絡するもんでしょっ。
romaji: shoukoinmetsu doosunnoyo! futsuu wa keisatsu ni renraku surumondeshotsu.
meaning: What does destroying evidence get you? The usual thing would be to contact the police, wouldn't it?

japanese: 約束するよ。
romaji: yakusoku suruyo.
meaning: I give you my word.

japanese: いつも同じ部屋を予約するのね。
romaji: itsumo onajiheya o yoyaku surunone.
meaning: You always reserve the same room.

japanese: これは遠慮する。
romaji: kore wa enryosuru.
meaning: This is to restrain, hold back.

japanese: つまらないものですがご笑納ください。
romaji: tsumaranaimonodesugago shounou kudasai.
meaning: Please accept this little gift.

japanese: 冷たいものを飲みたくてたまらない。
romaji: tsumetai monowo nomi takutetamaranai.
meaning: I'm dying for a cold drink.

japanese: 私は好奇心が強いです。
romaji: watashi wa koukishin ga tsuyoi desu.
meaning: I am curious.

japanese: ここから遠いの？
romaji: kokokara tooi no ？
meaning: Is it far from here?

japanese: マリアさんの髪は長いです。
romaji: maria sanno kami wa nagai desu.
meaning: Maria has long hair.

japanese: 恋の味は苦い。
romaji: koi no aji wa nigai.
meaning: The taste of love is bitter.

japanese: 夜更かしをしたので、とても眠いんだ。
romaji: yofukashi woshitanode, totemo nemui nda.
meaning: Since I stayed up late, I'm very sleepy.

japanese: 早く帰った方がいい、暑いから。サバは、生き腐れとも言われるくらい足が早い。
romaji: hayakukaetsu ta houga ii, atsui kara. saba ha, ikikusare tomo iwa rerukurai ashi ga hayai.
meaning: It's hot, so you'd better head back quickly. Mackerel goes off so fast that they coined 'fresh-looking rotten fish'.

japanese: オーボエ奏者なんかは自分にあうリードを探すより作った方が速いと、自分で作ってしまう人もいる。
romaji: ooboe sousha nankaha jibun niau riido o sagasu yori tsukutsu ta hougahayai to, jibun de tsukutsu teshimau nin moiru.
meaning: Heck, with oboe players there are those who, rather than search for a reed that suits them, find it faster to make their own.

japanese: シンナーなどの常習性のある物をしてると言う事は、更正する可能性が低いと思います。
romaji: shinnaa nadono joushuusei noaru mono woshiteruto iukoto ha, kousei suru kanousei ga hikui to omoi masu.
meaning: I think that, as he's using addictive substances like thinner, the chance of rehabilitation is low.

japanese: 門はその車が通れるほど広い。
romaji: mon hasono kuruma ga toure ruhodo hiroi.
meaning: The gate is wide enough for the car to go through.

japanese: 納豆の匂いは酷いけれど味は最高。
romaji: nattou no nioi wa hidoi keredo aji wa saikou.
meaning: "Natto" smells awful but tastes terrific.

japanese: 嵐のせいで、多くの飛行機が飛行場を飛びたてなかった。
romaji: arashi noseide, ooku no hikouki ga hikoujou o tobi tatenakatta.
meaning: The storm prevented many planes from leaving the airport.

japanese: 美術館の東の陳列棟は清掃のため閉鎖されていた。
romaji: bijutsukan no higashi no chinretsutou wa seisou notame heisa sareteita.
meaning: The museum's eastern gallery was closed for cleaning.

japanese: その間ずっと、じいさんの言ったことが、メロンの周りを飛び回る蠅の羽音のように、頭の中でぶんぶんと鳴っていました。
romaji: sono kan zutto, jiisanno itta kotoga, meron no mawari o tobimawaruhae no uon noyouni, atama no naka debunbunto natsu teimashita.
meaning: All that time the things granddad had said, like the sound of flies flying round a melon, buzzed in my head.

japanese: 約１時間歩くと私たちは湖の所に来た。
romaji: yaku 1 jikanaruku to watashitachi wa mizuumi no tokoro ni kita.
meaning: About an hour's walk brought us to the lake.

japanese: 嵐の時はどんな港でもよい。
romaji: arashi no toki hadonna minato demoyoi.
meaning: Any port in a storm.

japanese: 猟犬が森のほうにいった。
romaji: ryouken ga mori nohouniitta.
meaning: The hunting dog headed for the woods.

japanese: 旅館は、上げ膳据え膳がうれしいね。
romaji: ryokan ha, agezensuezen gaureshiine.
meaning: At a Japanese-style inn, they take care of your every need, so you don't have to lift a finger.

japanese: 彼は彼の研究室では「博士」と呼ばれている。
romaji: karehakanokenkyuushitsu deha ( hakase) to yoba reteiru.
meaning: He is addressed as "Doctor" in his laboratory.

japanese: 明日どこかの工場へ見学に行くんですよね。
romaji: ashita dokokano koujou e kengaku ni iku ndesuyone.
meaning: You're visiting a factory tomorrow, aren't you?

japanese: 彼女は展覧会で一等賞を得た。
romaji: kanojo wa tenrankai de ittoushou o eta.
meaning: She won first prize in the exhibition.

japanese: 小学５年の息子が静岡から名古屋の小学校に転入しました。
romaji: shougaku 5 nen no musuko ga shizuoka kara nagoya no shougakkou ni tennyuu shimashita.
meaning: My fifth-year junior school son has transferred into a school in Nagoya from Shizuoka.

japanese: こちらは私の友達のレイチェルです。私たちは同じ高校に通っていました。
romaji: kochiraha watashi no tomodachi no reicheru desu. watashitachi wa onajikoukou ni tootte imashita.
meaning: This is my friend Rachel. We went to high school together.

japanese: 彼は高等学校の生徒ではありません。
romaji: karehakoutougakkou no seito dehaarimasen.
meaning: He is not a high school student.

japanese: 世界的な全面核戦争が起これば、地球規模でこの「核の冬」が数カ月間も続くと言われています。
romaji: sekaiteki na zenmenkakusensou ga oko reba, chikyuukibo dekono ( kaku no fuyu) ga kazu ka gekkan mo tsuzuku to iwa reteimasu.
meaning: If there's a world-wide all-out nuclear war it's said that there will be a "nuclear winter" all over the planet for several months.

japanese: 「はい」と「いいえ」しか言わない人と会話を続けるのは難しい。
romaji: ( hai) to ( iie) shika iwa nai nin to kaiwa o tsuzuke runoha muzukashii.
meaning: It is difficult to keep up a conversation with someone who only says "yes" and "no".

japanese: 王手をかけられたほうは、玉を逃げるなどの方法で王手を防がねばなりません。
romaji: oute wokakeraretahouha, tama o nige runadono houhou de oute o fusega nebanarimasen.
meaning: The checked player must find a way for the king to escape and block the check.

japanese: 父は自分の車を光るまで磨いた。
romaji: chichi wa jibun no kuruma o hikaru made migai ta.
meaning: My father polished his car till it shone.

japanese: 今、キーボードがダブって見えるぐらい酔ってます。
romaji: ima, kiiboodo ga dabu tte mie rugurai yotsu temasu.
meaning: I'm so drunk now that I'm seeing two keyboards.

japanese: 別れるときになっても二人は抱き合っていた。
romaji: wakare rutokininattemo futari wa dakiatsu teita.
meaning: It was time to part, but still the couple clung together.

japanese: 民主党はまだ候補者を決めていないが、どっちにしても負けるに決まっている。
romaji: minshutou hamada kouhosha o kime teinaiga, dotchinishitemo make runi kima tteiru.
meaning: The Democrats haven't decided on their candidates yet, but in any case they're sure to lose.

japanese: 選挙に勝つには「見た目」が何割？
romaji: senkyo ni katsu niha ( mitame) ga nanwari ？
meaning: How much of winning an election is down to looks?

japanese: 足を踏むつもりはなかったのです。
romaji: ashi o fumu tsumorihanakattanodesu.
meaning: I didn't mean to step on your foot.

japanese: 空模様から判断するといつ降り出すかもわからない。
romaji: soramoyou kara handan surutoitsu oridasu kamowakaranai.
meaning: Judging from the look of the sky, it may rain at any moment.

japanese: 容易に試験に通ると思う。
romaji: youinishiken ni touru to omou.
meaning: I expect her to pass the examination easily.

japanese: 彼はその野ウサギを捕まえることができなかった。
romaji: kareha sono no usagi o tsukama erukotogadekinakatta.
meaning: He could not catch the hare.

japanese: 朝食用のパンはぎりぎり足りる。
romaji: choushokuyou no pan hagirigiri tari ru.
meaning: We have barely enough bread for breakfast.

japanese: ２回目の人工内耳移植への低所得者医療扶助制度の適用不許可を取り下げる。
romaji: 2 kaime no jinkounaijiishoku heno teishoemonoiryoufujoseido no tekiyoufukyoka o torisage ru.
meaning: Decision to disallow Medicaid for second cochlea implant withdrawn.

japanese: 毎朝必ず天気予報を見てから外出します。
romaji: maiasakanarazutenkiyohou o mite kara gaishutsu shimasu.
meaning: I always watch the weather report before going out in the morning.

japanese: 冬は私の一番好きな季節です。
romaji: fuyu wa watashi no ichibansuki na kisetsu desu.
meaning: Winter is my favorite season.

japanese: 暖かい軽い空気は山越えすると上空に上昇し、地上には下りてこないことなど、風は地形によって変わります。
romaji: atatakaikaruikuuki wa yamakoshi esuruto joukuu ni joushou shi, chijou niha kudari tekonaikotonado, kaze wa chikei niyotte kawari masu.
meaning: When warm, light, air crosses mountains it rises into the upper atmosphere and does not fall back to the ground. In this, and other, ways wind changes with the terrain.

japanese: 彼が料金を払わなかったので水道を止められた。
romaji: kare ga ryoukin o harawa nakattanode suidou o yamera reta.
meaning: They shut his water off because he didn't pay the bill.

japanese: 壁が地震で崩れた。
romaji: kabe ga jishin de kuzure ta.
meaning: The wall gave way in the earthquake.

japanese: 嵐は発達して台風になった。
romaji: arashi wa hattatsu shite taifuu ninatta.
meaning: The storm developed into a typhoon.

japanese: 廊下の突き当たりで火事が起きました。
romaji: rouka no tsukiatari de kaji ga oki mashita.
meaning: There's a fire down the hall.

japanese: 起こるべくして起こった事故だった。
romaji: oko rubekushite oko tta jiko datta.
meaning: It was an accident that was waiting to happen.

japanese: 私の母はあまり英語が上手に話せない。
romaji: watashi no haha haamari eigo ga jouzu ni hanase nai.
meaning: My mom doesn't speak English very well.

japanese: 私は料理をしますが、とんでもなく下手くそです。
romaji: watashi wa ryouri woshimasuga, tondemonaku heta kusodesu.
meaning: I cook, but I'm really crap at it.

japanese: 入学試験に落ちないように、彼女は一生懸命に勉強した。
romaji: nyuugakushiken ni ochi naiyouni, kanojo wa isshoukenmei ni benkyou shita.
meaning: She studied hard in order not to fail the entrance exam.

japanese: それをするためには危険を冒さなければならない。
romaji: sorewosurutameniha kiken o okasa nakerebanaranai.
meaning: In order to do that, you have to take risks.

japanese: 残念ながらそれは本当なのです。
romaji: zannen nagarasoreha hontou nanodesu.
meaning: It is unfortunately true.

japanese: 心配しないで。
romaji: shinpai shinaide.
meaning: Don't worry about it!

japanese: 自由について私に話したかったの？
romaji: jiyuu nitsuite watashi ni hanashi takattano ？
meaning: You wanted to tell me about freedom?

japanese: 金銭的に余裕があるのなら併用しても構わないが催眠だけで、十分に効果がある。
romaji: kinsenteki ni yoyuu gaarunonara heiyou shitemo kamawa naiga saimin dakede, juubun ni kouka gaaru.
meaning: If you have the money, then you may use it with other treatments, but the results from hypnotism alone should be plenty.

japanese: 私達は時々、ドライブを兼ねて大好きなラーメンを食べに行きます。
romaji: watashitachi wa tokidoki, doraibu o kane te daisuki na raamen o tabe ni iki masu.
meaning: We sometimes combine going for a drive with eating the ramen we love so.

japanese: 「きれいな宝石ですね」、適当な話題かどうかわからないが、とりあえずそう水を向けてみた。
romaji: ( kireina houseki desune), tekitou na wadai kadoukawakaranaiga, toriaezusou mizu o muke temita.
meaning: "Pretty gem, isn't it?" Not knowing if it was a suitable subject or not, but anyway I tried to get her interest that way.

japanese: 別にブルマに特別な関心があるわけじゃない。そういうフェティシズムはない、と思う。
romaji: betsuni buruma ni tokubetsu na kanshin gaaruwakejanai. souiu feteishizumu hanai, to omou.
meaning: It's not like I've got any special interest in gym shorts - I've not got that fetish, I think.

japanese: これに対して霊的なことがらに関する熱心な会話は、霊的な進歩に大いなる助けとなります。
romaji: koreni taishi te reitekina kotogarani kansu ru nesshin na kaiwa ha, reitekinashinpo ni ooi naru tasuke tonarimasu.
meaning: Nevertheless, devout conversation on spiritual things helps no little with spiritual progress.

japanese: 痩せる必要がないというのは残念だ。
romaji: yase ru hitsuyou ganaitoiunoha zannen da.
meaning: It's too bad that I don't need to lose weight.

japanese: 彼女達は真面目な子たちです。
romaji: kanojotachi wa majime na ko tachidesu.
meaning: They are sensible girls.

japanese: 真直ぐにその家から竹林まで伸びた道路は石畳で整備されておる。
romaji: manao gunisono ie kara chikurin made nobi ta douro wa ishidatami de seibi sareteoru.
meaning: The path stretching from that house to the bamboo thicket was laid with stone paving.

japanese: いつまでかかっても全部を説明するのは無理だ。
romaji: itsumadekakattemo zenbu o setsumeisu runoha muri da.
meaning: It would take forever for me to explain everything.

japanese: ニワトリの赤く立派なトサカは性別や種類を見分けるときに役立っていると考えられている。
romaji: niwatori no akakurippa na tosaka wa seibetsu ya shurui o miwake rutokini yakutatsu teiruto kangae rareteiru.
meaning: The cockerel's splendid red cockscomb is thought to play a part in determining gender and breed.

japanese: 夜会服は仕事をするには不便だ。
romaji: yakaifuku wa shigoto wosuruniha fuben da.
meaning: It is inconvenient to work in evening clothes.

japanese: 彼らはきっと恋におちる。
romaji: karera hakitto koi niochiru.
meaning: They are sure to fall in love.

japanese: そのコップを落すな。
romaji: sono koppu o otosu na.
meaning: Don't drop that cup.

japanese: 彼女が英語を話すのを聞くと、アメリカ人と間違えるでしょう。
romaji: kanojo ga eigo o hanasu nowo kiku to, amerika nin to machigae rudeshou.
meaning: If you heard her speak English, you would take her for an American.

japanese: 「委員長、後は何を運ぶんだっけ？」「得点板と大玉もう一個、綱引きの綱」
romaji: ( iinchou, nochi wa naniwohakobu ndakke ？) ( tokutenita to ootama mou ikko, tsunahiki kino tsuna)
meaning: "Mr Chairman, what needs moving next, again?" "Scoreboard, giant ball and the tug-of-war rope."

japanese: 日本では昼間でも夜でもタクシーを拾うことができる。
romaji: nippon deha hiruma demo yoru demo takushii o hirou kotogadekiru.
meaning: In Japan you can always catch a cab, day or night.

japanese: 約束の時間に間に合うようにタクシーに乗った。
romaji: yakusoku no jikan ni maniau youni takushii ni joutsu ta.
meaning: I took a taxi so that I would be in time for the appointment.

japanese: 僕は家が少し揺れるのを感じたが、君は？
romaji: bokuhaie ga sukoshiyure runowo kanji taga, kun wa ？
meaning: I felt the house shake a little. Didn't you?

japanese: 老齢は気づかぬうちに我々に忍び寄る。
romaji: rourei wa kizu kanuuchini wareware ni shinobiyoru.
meaning: Old age creeps upon us unnoticed.

japanese: 猫に石を投げるな。
romaji: neko ni ishi o nage runa.
meaning: Don't throw a stone at a cat.

japanese: 坂を下りるときに彼女のおんぼろ自転車はキーキー音を立てた。
romaji: saka o oriru tokini kanojo noonboro jitensha wa kiikii oto o tate ta.
meaning: Her old bike squeaked as she rode down the hill.

japanese: 私のパソコンは何かの役に立つはずだ。
romaji: watashi no pasokon wa nanika no yakunitatsu hazuda.
meaning: My computer has got to be useful for something.

japanese: 明日の晩五人のお客を迎えることになっている。
romaji: ashita no bangonin noo kyaku o mukae rukotoninatteiru.
meaning: We are to take in five guests tomorrow evening.

japanese: 息子は父親に似る。
romaji: musuko wa chichioya ni niru.
meaning: Like father, like son.

japanese: 新宿で電車を乗り換えるんだよ。
romaji: shinjuku de densha o norikae rundayo.
meaning: You have to change trains at Shinjuku.

japanese: 朝夕は冷えるので服装などに注意したい。
romaji: asayuu wa hie runode fukusou nadoni chuui shitai.
meaning: It gets cold in the mornings and evenings, so I want to take care how I dress.

japanese: これはお見えになります。
romaji: kore wa omieninarimasu.
meaning: This is to come (respectful).

japanese: 何を召し上がりますか。
romaji: naniwomeshiaga rimasuka.
meaning: What would you like to eat?

japanese: これはご覧になります。
romaji: kore wa goranninarimasu.
meaning: This is to look (respectful).

japanese: 名前は何とおっしゃいますか。
romaji: namae wa nanto osshaimasuka.
meaning: May I have your name, please?

japanese: お肉の焼き加減は、いかがなさいますか？
romaji: o niku no yakikagen ha, ikaganasaimasuka ？
meaning: How would you like your steak cooked?

japanese: 提出する前に私の論文に目を通して下さいますか。
romaji: teishutsu suru mae ni watashi no ronbun ni me o toushi te kudasai masuka.
meaning: Is my paper looked over before submitting?

japanese: 彼女がどこに住んでいるのか、もしやご存知ですか。
romaji: kanojo gadokoni sun deirunoka, moshiyago zonji desuka.
meaning: Do you happen to know where she lives?

japanese: これはお聞きになります。
romaji: kore wa okikininarimasu.
meaning: This is to hear (respectful).

japanese: これはお書きになります。
romaji: kore wa okakininarimasu.
meaning: This is to write (respectful).

japanese: これはお泳ぎになります。
romaji: kore wa ooyogininarimasu.
meaning: This is to swim (respectful).

japanese: これはお取りになります。
romaji: kore wa otorininarimasu.
meaning: This is to take (respectful).

japanese: これはお座りになります。
romaji: kore wa osuwarininarimasu.
meaning: This is to sit (respectful).

japanese: これはお会いになります。
romaji: kore wa oaininarimasu.
meaning: This is to meet (respectful).

japanese: これはお休みになります。
romaji: kore wa oyasumininarimasu.
meaning: This is to rest (respectful).

japanese: これはお上げになります。
romaji: kore wa oageninarimasu.
meaning: This is to give (respectful).

japanese: 社長さんの車種と色は？
romaji: shachou sanno shashu to iro wa ？
meaning: The colour and make of the president's car are?

japanese: 課長からもらった推薦状が物を言った。
romaji: kachou karamoratta suisenjou ga mono o itta.
meaning: The recommendation from my boss made all the difference.

japanese: あなたは充分可愛い女の子の範疇に入ると思います。部長のおめがねには余裕でかなってしまうでしょう。
romaji: anataha juubunkawaionnanoko no hanchuu ni iru to omoi masu. buchou noomeganeniha yoyuu dekanatteshimaudeshou.
meaning: I think you fall well within 'cute girl'. You'd easily go and pass in his judgement.

japanese: 彼は校長に昇進した。
romaji: karehakouchou ni shoushin shita.
meaning: He was promoted to the position of head teacher.

japanese: 高校生の時は毎朝6時に起きていた。
romaji: koukousei no toki wa maiasa 6 tokinioki teita.
meaning: Back in high school, I got up at 6 a.m. every morning.

japanese: 大学生の時、有理子が愛欲に身を委ねた。
romaji: daigakusei no toki, yuriko ga aiyoku ni miwoyudane ta.
meaning: When she was at university, Yuriko abandoned herself to sexual passion.

japanese: 公務員が秘密を漏らして、秘密漏洩罪として罰せられた。
romaji: koumuin ga himitsu o mora shite, himitsuroueitsumi toshite batsu serareta.
meaning: The public servant leaked the secret and he was prosecuted for revealing a state secret.

japanese: 彼女はスーパーマーケットの店員である。
romaji: kanojo wa suupaamaaketto no ten'in dearu.
meaning: She is a clerk in the supermarket.

japanese: 彼女はタクシーの運転手ですか。
romaji: kanojo wa takushii no untenshu desuka.
meaning: Is she a taxi driver?

japanese: 普通の看護師は、ちんこに溲瓶も添えるし手術の時は剃毛もするぞ。
romaji: futsuu no kangoshi ha, chinkoni shibin mo soe rushi shujutsu no toki wa teimou mosuruzo.
meaning: A typical nurse will do such things as helping with a urinal bottle, and shaving in preparation for surgery!

japanese: 前の歯医者さんに、たばこをやめるなら、ヤニ取りしてあげる・・・といわれたそうです。
romaji: mae no haisha sanni, tabakowoyamerunara, yani tori shiteageru ・・・ toiwaretasoudesu.
meaning: He said that his previous dentist told him that he'd remove nicotine stains if he stopped smoking.

japanese: 夫と娘はぐっすりと眠っている。
romaji: otto to musume hagussurito nemutsu teiru.
meaning: My husband and daughter are fast asleep.

japanese: 泥棒は、間違いなくここにいるはずよ。きっと、どこかに根城があるから、そこを見つけさえすればいいの。
romaji: dorobou ha, machigai nakukokoniiruhazuyo. kitto, dokokani nejiro gaarukara, sokowo mitsu kesaesurebaiino.
meaning: The thief has to be in here. I'm sure somewhere around is his stronghold so if we can just find that we've got him.

japanese: 赤ん坊の世話を焼けるのが嬉しい。
romaji: akanbou no sewa o yake runoga ureshii.
meaning: I'm very happy that I can take care of the baby.

japanese: 夫との間に波風が立つのが恐くて、愛人の存在は知らない振りをしています。
romaji: otto tono maninamikaze ga tatsu noga kowaku te, aijin no sonzai wa shira nai furi woshiteimasu.
meaning: I'm afraid of discord arising with my husband so I'm turning a blind eye to his mistress.

japanese: これは御主人。
romaji: kore wa goshujin.
meaning: This is (honorable) your husband.

japanese: 『極道の妻たち』は、1986年、東映配給網により公開されたヤクザ映画。
romaji: ( gokudou no tsuma tachi) ha, 1986 nen, toueihaikyuumou niyori koukai sareta yakuza eiga.
meaning: "Gang Wives" is a Yakuza movie released in 1986 by Toei Distribution Network.

japanese: 家内もお目にかかることを楽しみにしておりますから。
romaji: kanai moo meni kakarukotowo tanoshimi nishiteorimasukara.
meaning: My wife will be glad to see you, too.

japanese: 私も親の面倒とか見られないですね。
romaji: watashi mo oya no mendou toka mira renaidesune.
meaning: I can't look after my parents and such either.

japanese: もう彼女には言えないよ。そんなに単純なことではなくなってきたからね。
romaji: mou kanojo niha ie naiyo. sonnani tanjunna kotodehanakunattekitakarane.
meaning: I can't tell her now. It's not that simple anymore.

japanese: 彼は時々変です。
romaji: karehatokidokihende su.
meaning: Sometimes he can be a strange guy.

japanese: この世界の教育にはがっかりしてしまう。
romaji: kono sekai no kyouiku nihagakkarishiteshimau.
meaning: Education in this world disappoints me.

japanese: 祖父は祖母がぽっくり逝ってから急に老け込みました。
romaji: sofu wa sobo gapokkuri itsu tekara kyuunifukekomi mashita.
meaning: After Grandma's sudden death, Grandpa began to age rapidly.

japanese: 祖母の遺灰は寺院に置かれた骨壷に入っている。
romaji: sobo no ikai wa jiin ni oka reta kotsutsubo ni itsutsu teiru.
meaning: Grandmother's ashes are in an urn at the temple.

japanese: 小学５年の息子が静岡から名古屋の小学校に転入しました。
romaji: shougaku 5 nen no musuko ga shizuoka kara nagoya no shougakkou ni tennyuu shimashita.
meaning: My fifth-year junior school son has transferred into a school in Nagoya from Shizuoka.

japanese: 私の娘は尻が重いので困る。
romaji: watashi no musume wa shiri ga omoi node komaru.
meaning: My daughter's slowness to take action is a pain.

japanese: 石油が太いパイプの中を流れた。
romaji: sekiyu ga futoi paipu no naka o nagare ta.
meaning: The oil ran through a thick pipe.

japanese: 町田は古いものと新しいものが入り交じった面白い街です。
romaji: machida wa furui monoto atarashii monoga irimaji tta omoshiroimachi desu.
meaning: Machida is an interesting city that's a mix of the old and the new.

japanese: この端午の節句と関係の深いしょうぶは、花は美しくありません。
romaji: kono tango no sekku to kankei no fukai shoubuha, hana wa utsukushiku arimasen.
meaning: The iris deeply associated with the Boys' Festival does not have a beautiful flower.

japanese: 欲しいものがみつかると、決まって高いものだ。
romaji: hoshii monogamitsukaruto, kima tte takai monoda.
meaning: Whenever I find something I like, it's too expensive.

japanese: 彼は太っているくせに声は細い。
romaji: karehafutotsu teirukuseni koe wa komai.
meaning: His voice is thin even though he is fat.

japanese: このフルーツは不味い。
romaji: kono furuutsu wa mazui.
meaning: This fruit has a bad taste.

japanese: 林檎の形は丸い。
romaji: ringo no katachi wa marui.
meaning: An apple is round in shape.

japanese: 私は気が短いし、口も軽い男だ。
romaji: watashi wa kigamijikai shi, kuchi mo karuiotoko da.
meaning: I'm short-tempered, and a loose-tongued man.

japanese: 「はい」と「いいえ」しか言わない人と会話を続けるのは難しい。
romaji: ( hai) to ( iie) shika iwa nai nin to kaiwa o tsuzuke runoha muzukashii.
meaning: It is difficult to keep up a conversation with someone who only says "yes" and "no".

japanese: 彼ほど平々凡々たる主人公は珍しい。
romaji: kareho do heiheibonbon taru shujinkou wa mezurashii.
meaning: A protagonist as plain and ordinary as him is rare indeed.

japanese: ハルくんは昔からこうなの、心根は凄く優しいのよ。
romaji: haru kunha mukashi karakounano, kokorone wa sugokuyasashii noyo.
meaning: Haru's always been like that; he's very kind at heart.

japanese: 楽器・機材の質は完全にプロ仕様！ですが値段は何処よりも安い！
romaji: gakki ・ kizai no shitsu wa kanzen ni puro shiyou! desuga nedan wa doko yorimo yasui!
meaning: The musical instruments and parts are completely professional quality! And yet the prices are lower than anywhere!

japanese: 柔らかいものだけを食べてくださいね。
romaji: yawarakai monodakewo tabete kudasaine.
meaning: Please eat only soft foods.

japanese: 窓を開けても宜しいですか。
romaji: mado o hirake temo yoroshii desuka.
meaning: Can I open the window?

japanese: 老人はしばしば若いころのことを回顧する。
romaji: roujin hashibashiba wakai koronokotowo kaiko suru.
meaning: The old man often looks back on his youth.

japanese: 馬鹿が移るまえにそのような宗教に関わらんほうがいい。
romaji: baka ga utsuru maenisonoyouna shuukyou ni kakawa ranhougaii.
meaning: You should stay away from cults like that before you turn into a moron.

japanese: 彼女は学校に通うために自転車を買いました。
romaji: kanojo wa gakkou ni kayou tameni jitensha o kai mashita.
meaning: She bought a bicycle in order to go to school.

japanese: 急げば急ぐほど物事はうまくいかない。
romaji: isoge ba isogu hodo monogoto haumakuikanai.
meaning: More haste, less speed.

japanese: 「あれ？恵子は？」「今日は三者面談だから遅れるって」
romaji: ( are ？ keiko wa ？) ( konnichihasanshamendan dakara okure rutte)
meaning: "Eh? Where's Keiko?" "Said she's got a parent and child meeting so she'll be late."

japanese: 彼は友達のノートを写すのに忙しかった。
romaji: karehatomodachi no nooto o utsusu noni isogashika tta.
meaning: He was busy copying his friend's notebook.

japanese: 私はもっと敵の抵抗があると踏んでたんだけど、むしろ中枢に進むほど敵が減ってきてる・・・。おかしいと思わないかしら？
romaji: watashi hamotto teki no teikou gaaruto fun detandakedo, mushiro chuusuu ni susumu hodo teki ga hetsu tekiteru ・・・. okashiito omowa naikashira ？
meaning: I had expected stronger resistance from the enemy but if anything there are less of them as we advance to the centre... Don't you think that's strange?

japanese: ここにゴミ捨てるべからず。
romaji: kokoni gomi sute rubekarazu.
meaning: No dumping rubbish here!

japanese: 誰の助けもかりないで済むものはいない。
romaji: dare no tasuke mokarinaide sumu monohainai.
meaning: Nobody can dispense with somebody's service.

japanese: 教室に入って席に着くのとほぼ同時に、始業を知らせるチャイムの音が鳴り響く。
romaji: kyoushitsu ni itsutsu te seki ni tsuku notohobo doujini, shigyou o shirase ru chaimu no oto ga narihibiku.
meaning: About the same time as he entered the classroom and arrived at his seat, the chime to announce class rings across the school.

japanese: とにかくメシ・・・といきたいところだが、その前に用を足すことにした。
romaji: tonikaku meshi・・・ toikitaitokorodaga, sono mae ni mochiwotasu kotonishita.
meaning: Anyhow, lunch ... is where I wanted to go but I decided to go to the toilet first.

japanese: 高校時代について最も後悔することを人々に尋ねると大抵の人は決まってこう言う。時間を無駄にしすぎていた、と。
romaji: koukoujidai nitsuite mottomokoukai surukotowo hitobito ni tazune ruto taitei no nin wa kima ttekou iu. jikan o muda nishisugiteita, to.
meaning: When I ask people what they regret most about high school, they nearly all say the same thing: that they wasted so much time.

japanese: 頷いたり、手を叩いたり、ほほえんだり、また、爆笑したりして承認を伝える。
romaji: unazui tari, te o tatai tari, hohoendari, mata, bakushou shitarishite shounin o tsutae ru.
meaning: People communicate approval by nodding, by clapping their hands, by smiling or laughing.

japanese: ああ、男に二言はない。でも手伝うだけだからな。美咲もやれよ。
romaji: aa, otoko ni nigon hanai. demo tetsudau dakedakarana. misaki moyareyo.
meaning: Yes, a man is as good as his word. But I'll just be helping, you understand. You'll have to work too.

japanese: 彼女はシンジに、明日レイにＩＤカードを届けるよう頼んだ。
romaji: kanojo wa shinji ni, ashita rei ni I D kaado o todoke ruyou tanon da.
meaning: She asked Shinji to take Rei's ID-card to her the next day.

japanese: 瞼が大きく開く。
romaji: mabuta ga ookikuhiraku.
meaning: An eyelid opens wide.

japanese: 国王はいつも自分を褒めるおべっか使いにうんざりしていたので彼らを遠くへ飛ばした。
romaji: kokuou haitsumo jibun o home ruobekka tsukai niunzarishiteitanode karera o tooku e toba shita.
meaning: The king was tired of his sycophants always praising him, so he sent them away.

japanese: いい監督を探すのに3年費やしたが、見つからなかった。
romaji: ii kantoku o sagasu noni 3 nentsuiyashi taga, mitsu karanakatta.
meaning: I spent three years looking for a good director, but couldn't find one.

japanese: 曇天の日は晴天のときより音がよく聞こえるのです。
romaji: donten no nichi wa seiten notokiyori oto gayoku kiko erunodesu.
meaning: On cloudy days, you can hear distant sounds better than in clear weather.

japanese: 青春期がどのくらい長く続くかは生物学的要因によって決る。
romaji: seishunki gadonokurai nagakutsuzuku kaha seibutsugakutekiyouin niyotte kimaru.
meaning: How long adolescence continues is determined by biological factors.

japanese: 私たちがそこへ行くかどうかを決めるのは君の責任だ。
romaji: watashitachi gasokohe iku kadoukawo kime runoha kun no sekinin da.
meaning: It is up to you to decide whether we will go there or not.

japanese: 犬の聴覚の敏感さを人間と比べると、はるかに上だ。
romaji: inu no choukaku no binkan sawo ningen to kurabe ruto, harukani ueda.
meaning: The hearing acuity of dogs is superior by far to that of humans.

japanese: 私よりもっとエッチな人もいて安心しました。
romaji: watashi yorimotto etchi na nin moite anshinshi mashita.
meaning: I was relieved that there are people more wanton than me.

japanese: アフリカ大陸のどこかへ行くとしたらどこが一番衛生的で安全ですか？
romaji: afurika tairiku nodokokahe iku toshitaradokoga ichibaneiseiteki de anzen desuka ？
meaning: If I was going to the African continent where would be the safest and most sanitary place?

japanese: 車の速度を落とす装置（ハンプや狭さく）について、意見があったら書いてください。
romaji: kuruma no sokudo o oto su souchi ( hanpu ya semasa ku) nitsuite, iken gaattara kai tekudasai.
meaning: If you have any opinions concerning traffic calming devices (humps, curb extensions, etc.) please write them.

japanese: ただ、調子を合わせているんじゃない。本当に、私の気持ちを分かっていて同情している目だった。
romaji: tada, choushi o awa seteirunjanai. hontou ni, watashi no kimochi o waka tteite doujou shiteiru meda tta.
meaning: He wasn't just humouring me. Those were the eyes of someone who really understood my feelings and sympathised.

japanese: 残念ながらそれは本当なのです。
romaji: zannen nagarasoreha hontou nanodesu.
meaning: It is unfortunately true.

japanese: 親切にしてやればつけあがる。
romaji: shinsetsu nishiteyarebatsukeagaru.
meaning: Give him an inch and he'll take a yard.

japanese: お楽しみいただけましたら、ポチっと１票お願いいたします！
romaji: o tanoshimi itadakemashitara, pochi tto 1 hyou o negai itashimasu!
meaning: If you enjoyed this, please give a click on the vote link!

japanese: 例えば、たばこをぷかぷか吸う先生が、たばこを吸う生徒に注意してもその注意は矛盾しているだろう。
romaji: tatoeba, tabakowopukapuka suusensei ga, tabakowo suuseito ni chuui shitemosono chuui wa mujun shiteirudarou.
meaning: For example, if a chain-smoking teacher cautions a pupil for smoking, that warning is self-contradictory.

japanese: 「きれいな宝石ですね」、適当な話題かどうかわからないが、とりあえずそう水を向けてみた。
romaji: ( kireina houseki desune), tekitou na wadai kadoukawakaranaiga, toriaezusou mizu o muke temita.
meaning: "Pretty gem, isn't it?" Not knowing if it was a suitable subject or not, but anyway I tried to get her interest that way.

japanese: 彼らのコミュニケーションは我々が考えてきたものよりはるかに複雑かもしれません。
romaji: karera no komyunikeeshon wa wareware ga kangae tekitamonoyoriharukani fukuzatsu kamoshiremasen.
meaning: Their communication may be much more complex than we thought.

japanese: 味も濃厚で、炒め物、スープなど中華料理に深みを与えます。
romaji: aji mo noukou de, itamemono, suupu nado chuukaryouri ni fukami o atae masu.
meaning: It also has a strong flavour, and adds depth to Chinese food such as soups and stir-fries.

japanese: お世話になった全ての方々にお礼の言葉を述べたいと思います。
romaji: o sewa ninatta subete no katagata nio rei no kotoba o nobe taito omoi masu.
meaning: I'd like to say a word of thanks to all those gentlemen and ladies whose care I have been in.

japanese: 有難くも、10000hit越えのお祝いイラストを頂いてしまいました！本当にかたじけないです。
romaji: arigataku mo, 10000hit koe noo iwai irasuto o itadai teshimaimashita! hontou nikatajikenaidesu.
meaning: I'm very lucky to have been gifted with this 10,000 hit picture! Thank you so very much.

japanese: 僕らは青春の真っ只中だ。
romaji: bokura wa seishun no mattadanaka da.
meaning: We are in the heyday of youth.

japanese: お互いを信頼し合うしかない。
romaji: o tagai o shinrai shi au shikanai.
meaning: All you can do is trust one another.

japanese: 私たちは兄弟として共に生きることを知らなければならない。さもなくば、愚か者として共に滅びるであろう。
romaji: watashitachi wa kyoudai toshite tomoniiki rukotowo shira nakerebanaranai. samonakuba, orokamono toshite tomonihorobi rudearou.
meaning: We must learn to live together as brothers, or we will perish together as fools.

japanese: 肩関節は、単独で動くほか、腕の動きにも連動して動きます。
romaji: katakansetsu ha, tandoku de ugoku hoka, ude no ugoki nimo rendou shite ugoki masu.
meaning: The shoulder joints, as well as moving on their own, also move in conjunction with arm movements.

japanese: 彼のいいところを引き出すようにしなさい。
romaji: kano iitokorowo hikidasu younishinasai.
meaning: Try to bring out the best in him.

japanese: 除草剤耐性品種でなぜ収量が増えるのか？
romaji: josouzaitaiseihinshu denaze shuuryou ga fue runoka ？
meaning: Why do yields increase with herbicide-resistant varieties?

japanese: 花火の弾ける音が止むと、急に辺りが静かになる。後に残った火薬の匂いが、なんだか俺をセンチメンタルな気分にさせた。
romaji: hanabi no hike ru oto ga tomu to, kyuuniatari ga shizuka ninaru. nochininokotsu ta kayaku no nioi ga, nandaka ore o senchimentaru na kibun nisaseta.
meaning: As the popping sound of the fireworks stopped, it suddenly became quiet around me. The smell of gunpowder somehow put me in a sentimental mood.

japanese: 父にとって酒を止めるのは難しい。
romaji: chichi nitotte sake o yameru noha muzukashii.
meaning: It's hard for my father to give up drinking.

japanese: 肥大化、過度の商業化などの問題も抱えて、五輪は新世紀に向かう。
romaji: hidaika, kado no shougyouka nadono mondai mo kakae te, gorin wa shinseiki ni muka u.
meaning: Despite the problems of excessive commercialization, etc. the Olympics will go forward into the new century.

japanese: 惑星は恒星の周りを回る。
romaji: wakusei wa kousei no mawari o mawaru.
meaning: Planets move around a fixed star.

japanese: 驚くこと、不思議に思うことは理解し始めるということなんだ。
romaji: odoroku koto, fushigi ni omou kotoha rikai shi hajime rutoiukotonanda.
meaning: To be surprised, to wonder, is to begin to understand.

japanese: その液から溶剤を揮発させる。残るのは、香り成分と植物ワックスの塊。
romaji: sono eki kara youzai o kihatsu saseru. nokoru noha, kaoriseibun to shokubutsu wakkusu no kai.
meaning: Vaporise the solvent from the liquid. What's left is the perfume component and a lump of vegetable wax.

japanese: 目に付くものが欲しいものだ。
romaji: menitsuku monoga hoshii monoda.
meaning: What you see is what you want.

japanese: いかにも敬虔なるクリスチャンが送る、礼節重き言葉です。
romaji: ikanimo keiken naru kurisuchan ga okuru, reisetsuomokikotoba desu.
meaning: So characteristic of what a pious Christian would say, this courteous phrase.

japanese: 重大な罪については、指導者に告白しなければ赦しを受けることができないとも教えています。
romaji: juudainatsumi nitsuiteha, shidousha ni kokuhaku shinakereba yurushi o ukeru kotogadekinaitomo oshie teimasu.
meaning: They also teach that, for great sins, they cannot receive forgiveness unless they confess to their leader.

japanese: たまにはビール以外のお酒をちびちび舐めるのも良いでしょう。
romaji: tamaniha biiru igai noo sake wochibichibi name runomo yoi deshou.
meaning: It's nice to sip and savour drinks other than beer as well from time to time.

japanese: ハロー、問題が解決したよ。以上お知らせでした。
romaji: haroo, mondai ga kaiketsu shitayo. ijou o shirase deshita.
meaning: Hi, I just wanted to let you know that the problem is fixed.

japanese: 横浜近郊にご在住の方、ご都合がよろしければ、お出で下さいませ。
romaji: yokohamakinkou nigo zaijuu no hou, go tsugou gayoroshikereba, o idekudasai mase.
meaning: Those ladies and gentlemen who live in the suburbs of Yokohama, if it is convenient to you, please come.

japanese: もっと成績を気にかけられればいいのだけれど、でも自分の人生のある点において成績はそんなに重要ではないと分かったんだ。
romaji: motto seiseki o kini kakerarerebaiinodakeredo, demo jibun no jinsei noaru ten nioite seiseki hasonnani juuyou dehanaito waka ttanda.
meaning: I wish I could care more about my grades but it seems that, at a certain point of my life, I decided they wouldn't be so important anymore.

japanese: 自転車は都会の環境を破壊することなく資源利用を持続することのできる道具である。
romaji: jitensha wa tokai no kankyou o hakai surukotonaku shigenriyou o jizoku surukotonodekiru dougu dearu.
meaning: Bicycles are tools for urban sustainability.

japanese: 霊はこの世のどこにもいらっしゃいます。この学園はお社の跡地に作られていますので、特にお集まりになる傾向があります。
romaji: rei hakono yono dokonimoirasshaimasu. kono gakuen hao sha no atochi ni tsukura reteimasunode, tokuni o atsumari ninaru keikou gaarimasu.
meaning: Spirits are to be found all over the world. This school was built upon the site of a shrine and thus there is a particular tendency for them to gather.

japanese: 何人も、拷問又は残虐な、非人道的な若しくは屈辱的な取扱若しくは刑罰を受けることはない。
romaji: nannin mo, goumonmatahazangyaku na, hijindouteki na moshikuhakutsujokuteki na toriatsukaimoshikuhakeibatsu o ukeru kotohanai.
meaning: No one shall be subjected to torture or to cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment.

japanese: 心情的には賛成、けれど現実的に反対します。
romaji: shinjouteki niha sansei, keredo genjitsuteki ni hantai shimasu.
meaning: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.

japanese: 父は自分の髪の刈り方について非常にやかましい。
romaji: chichi wa jibun no kami no karihou nitsuite hijouni yakamashii.
meaning: My father is very particular about the way his hair is cut.

japanese: 別の理由があるね？どう？図星でしょう？
romaji: betsunoriyuu gaarune ？ dou ？ zuboshi deshou ？
meaning: There's another reason, isn't there? Well, how did I do? I bet I hit the mark.

japanese: 私はひざを曲げずに両方の手のひらを床に付けることができる。
romaji: watashi hahizawo mage zuni ryouhou no teno hirawo toko ni tsukeru kotogadekiru.
meaning: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.

japanese: 理論上、理論と実行の間には何の違いもないが、実際上違いはあるものだ。
romaji: rironjou, riron to jikkou no mani wa nannochigai monaiga, jissaijouchigai haarumonoda.
meaning: In theory, there is no difference between theory and practice. But, in practice, there is.

japanese: 私は駅から二百メートル以内に住んでいます。
romaji: watashi wa eki kara nihyaku meetoru inai ni sun deimasu.
meaning: I live within 200 meters of the station.

japanese: 靴の裏にガムがこびりついちゃった。
romaji: kutsu no ura ni gamu gakobiritsuichatta.
meaning: There's gum stuck to the bottom of my shoe.

japanese: 沈黙は同意を表す。
romaji: chinmoku wa doui o arawasu.
meaning: Silence gives consent.

japanese: 小道の真中に止めてある車は迷惑だ。
romaji: komichi no mannaka ni tome tearu kuruma wa meiwaku da.
meaning: That car in the middle of the path is an inconvenience.

japanese: ここから遠くまで行けるボートが欲しいです。
romaji: kokokara tooku made ike ru booto ga hoshii desu.
meaning: I want a boat that will take me far away from here.

japanese: カミナリが光ったその後【くわばらくわばら】と唱えたもしくは、唱える人を見たことがあるだろう。
romaji: kaminari ga hikatsu tasono nochi ( kuwabarakuwabara) to tonae tamoshikuha, tonae ru nin o mita kotogaarudarou.
meaning: I expect you've chanted "kuwabara kuwabara" after a lightning flash, or have seen somebody do so.

japanese: 流れ星が空を駆けた。
romaji: nagareboshi ga sora o kake ta.
meaning: A shooting star dashed through the sky.

japanese: 恐い話が聞きたいなら、数週間前に私が見た夢のことを話してあげるよ。
romaji: kowaihanashi ga kiki tainara, suushuukanmae ni watashi ga mitayume nokotowo hanashi teageruyo.
meaning: If you want to hear a scary story, I'll tell you about a dream I had a few weeks ago.

japanese: 彼らは１時間３マイルの割合で歩いた。
romaji: karera wa 1 jikan 3 mairu no wariai de arui ta.
meaning: They walked at the rate of three miles an hour.

japanese: 必要のない語はどれでも線を引いて消さねばならない。
romaji: hitsuyou nonai go hadoredemo sen o hii te kesa nebanaranai.
meaning: You should cross out any word you don't need.

japanese: 彼女は妻？あなたも隅に置けないわねえ。
romaji: kanojo wa tsuma ？ anatamo sumi ni oke naiwanee.
meaning: She's your wife? There's more to you than meets the eye.

japanese: 来年私はあなたの３倍の年齢になる。
romaji: rainenwatashi haanatano 3 bai no nenrei ninaru.
meaning: Next year I will be three times as old as you.

japanese: 良くなったら伺います。
romaji: yoku nattara ukagai masu.
meaning: I will come and see you when I get well.

japanese: 明朝必ず参ります。
romaji: myouchoukanarazumairi masu.
meaning: I'll come without fail tomorrow morning.

japanese: 自己紹介させて頂きます。
romaji: jikoshoukai sasete itadaki masu.
meaning: Let me introduce myself.

japanese: 自己紹介させて頂きます。
romaji: jikoshoukai sasete itadaki masu.
meaning: Let me introduce myself.

japanese: これは頂戴します。
romaji: kore wa choudaishimasu.
meaning: This is to receive (humble) (いただく).

japanese: 食後にコーヒーを差し上げます。
romaji: shokugo ni koohii o sashiage masu.
meaning: Coffee will be served after the meal.

japanese: 搭乗券を拝見します。
romaji: toujouken o haiken shimasu.
meaning: May I see your boarding pass, please?

japanese: 問題となっている事件については、後便で詳しく申し上げます。
romaji: mondai tonatteiru jiken nitsuiteha, koubin de kuwashikumoushiage masu.
meaning: With regard to the matter in question, I will write to you in detail later.

japanese: 鈴木と申します。
romaji: suzuki to moushi masu.
meaning: This is Mr Suzuki speaking.

japanese: 内容が件名で判断出来ますので、記入をお願い致します。
romaji: naiyou ga kenmei de handandekima sunode, kinyuu woo negaiitashi masu.
meaning: I use the subject line to determine the contents so please fill it in.

japanese: お気の毒に存じ上げます。
romaji: o kinodoku ni zonjiage masu.
meaning: I'm sorry for you.

japanese: 初めてお目にかかります。
romaji: hajimete o meni kakarimasu.
meaning: I am glad to make your acquaintance.

japanese: 良くなったら伺います。
romaji: yoku nattara ukagai masu.
meaning: I will come and see you when I get well.

japanese: 良くなったら伺います。
romaji: yoku nattara ukagai masu.
meaning: I will come and see you when I get well.

japanese: 私たちはオーストラリアの若者を代表してお話しします。
romaji: watashitachi wa oosutoraria no wakamono o daihyou shiteo hanashi shimasu.
meaning: We are speaking on behalf of the young people of Australia.

japanese: ちょっとお待ちください、受領書をお書きします。
romaji: chottoo machi kudasai, juryousho woo kaki shimasu.
meaning: Please wait a moment while I write out your receipt.

japanese: これはお泳ぎします。
romaji: kore wa ooyogishimasu.
meaning: This is to swim (humble).

japanese: これはお取りします。
romaji: kore wa otorishimasu.
meaning: This is to take (humble).

japanese: これはお座りします。
romaji: kore wa osuwarishimasu.
meaning: This is to sit (humble).

japanese: これはお休みします。
romaji: kore wa oyasumishimasu.
meaning: This is to rest (humble).

japanese: 彼が新進気鋭の学者と新聞で紹介された男かい。
romaji: kare ga shinshinkiei no gakusha to shinbun de shoukai sareta otoko kai.
meaning: Is he the man painted by the newspapers as an up-and-coming scholar?

japanese: 私の力を甘く見ないで。
romaji: watashi no chikara o amakumina ide.
meaning: Don't underestimate my power.

japanese: 人生とは、他の予定を立てることに忙しくしている時に起こる現象のことだ。
romaji: jinsei toha, hokanoyotei o tate rukotoni isogashiku shiteiru tokinioko ru genshou nokotoda.
meaning: Life is what happens to you while you're busy making other plans.

japanese: 同世代の人は、仕事とか、買い物で留守ばかりです。
romaji: dousedai no nin ha, shigoto toka, kaimono de rusu bakaridesu.
meaning: My contemporaries are, working, shopping, out and about, all the time.

japanese: 彼女は昨日英語の発音を練習した。
romaji: kanojo wa kinoueigo no hatsuon o renshuu shita.
meaning: She practiced her English pronunciation yesterday.

japanese: 来週になると、何十万人もの人がその番組を見ているだろう。
romaji: raishuu ninaruto, nanjuumannin mono nin gasono bangumi o mite irudarou.
meaning: Next week, millions of people will be watching the TV program.

japanese: PC内部のタイマー用ボタン電池が切れた。
romaji: PC naibu no taimaa you botan denchi ga kire ta.
meaning: The button battery in the PC's internal timer has gone flat.

japanese: 旅行にいく用意をしなさい。
romaji: ryokou niiku youi woshinasai.
meaning: Please prepare for the trip.

japanese: 父は用事で年２回シドニーへ行く。
romaji: chichi wa youji de nen 2 kai shidonii e iku.
meaning: My father goes to Sydney twice a year on business.

japanese: 最悪の場合を考えておこう。
romaji: saiaku no baai o kangae teokou.
meaning: Let's consider the worst that could happen.

japanese: 虫の音がきこえます。
romaji: mushi no oto gakikoemasu.
meaning: I can hear the chirping of insects.

japanese: 例えば、小鳥は特別な防御装置を備えている。
romaji: tatoeba, kotori wa tokubetsu na bougyosouchi o sonae teiru.
meaning: Birds, for instance, have a special protective device.

japanese: 模擬試験に何回も失敗して、実際に受けてみたら思わぬ結果が出た。
romaji: mogishiken ni nankai mo shippai shite, jissainiuke temitara omowa nu kekka ga deta.
meaning: Having failed my mock examinations any number of times, when I actually tried taking it the result was nothing I'd imagined.

japanese: 自由について私に話したかったの？
romaji: jiyuu nitsuite watashi ni hanashi takattano ？
meaning: You wanted to tell me about freedom?

japanese: 金銭的に余裕があるのなら併用しても構わないが催眠だけで、十分に効果がある。
romaji: kinsenteki ni yoyuu gaarunonara heiyou shitemo kamawa naiga saimin dakede, juubun ni kouka gaaru.
meaning: If you have the money, then you may use it with other treatments, but the results from hypnotism alone should be plenty.

japanese: 檻に入れられた虎は盛んに尾を振った。
romaji: ran ni ire rareta tora wa sakan ni o o futsu ta.
meaning: The caged tiger lashed its tail.

japanese: 輸出は３００億ドル増加した。
romaji: yushutsu wa 3 0 0 oku doru zouka shita.
meaning: The exports increased by 30 billion dollars.

japanese: 驚くことではないね。
romaji: odoroku kotodehanaine.
meaning: It doesn't surprise me.

japanese: 万一彼が君の結婚のことを聞こうものなら、彼はものすごく怒るだろう。
romaji: man'ichikare ga kun no kekkon nokotowo kiko umononara, kareha monosugoku ikaru darou.
meaning: Should he hear of your marriage, he will be furious.

japanese: みんなもそうなのかな、と思うことくらいしかできない。
romaji: minnamosounanokana, to omou kotokuraishikadekinai.
meaning: I can only wonder if this is the same for everyone else.

japanese: 文法屋に聞きたいんですが、「be+分詞」はV Cなどのように考えることはできないんですか？
romaji: bunpouya ni kiki taindesuga, ( be+ bunshi) wa V C nadonoyouni kangae rukotohadekinaindesuka ？
meaning: I'd like to ask a grammarian, isn't it possible to think of 'be + participle' like you do V C and such?

japanese: 彼女は私たちに、騒ぐな、といった。
romaji: kanojo wa watashitachi ni, sawagu na, toitta.
meaning: She told us not to make a noise.

japanese: これは楽む。
romaji: kore wa tanoshimu.
meaning: This is to enjoy oneself.

japanese: 彼がそれを聞いたら喜ぶよ。
romaji: kare gasorewo kii tara yorokobu yo.
meaning: He would be glad to hear that.

japanese: な、なにか笑うところありました？あすか、ギャグってました？
romaji: na, nanika warau tokoroarimashita ？ asuka, gyagu ttemashita ？
meaning: Did I say something funny? Did I make a joke?

japanese: してもいないことをどうして謝るの？
romaji: shitemoinaikotowodoushite ayamaru no ？
meaning: Why are you sorry for something you haven't done?

japanese: 基本はアスカがシンジをいじめる。で、たまにキレたシンジがアスカを襲う。その時のアスカはやけにしおらしい。
romaji: kihon wa asuka ga shinji woijimeru. de, tamani kire ta shinji ga asuka o osou. sono tokino asuka hayakenishiorashii.
meaning: The key is that Asuka abuses Shinji. So, rarely, Shinji flips and assaults Asuka. Then Asuka is surprisingly meek.

japanese: 諸神は悪を雷で打つという。
romaji: shoshin wa aku o kaminari de utsu toiu.
meaning: They say the gods smite evil with thunderbolts.

japanese: さぁ笑って、泣くのは後！
romaji: saa waratsu te, naku noha nochi!
meaning: Smile now, cry later!

japanese: 今まで使っていたものを今朝部屋でボール遊びをしていて、わってしまったのです。
romaji: imamadetsukatte itamonowo kesaheya de booru asobi woshiteite, watteshimattanodesu.
meaning: I broke the one I've been using till now this morning while playing with a ball in the room.

japanese: 踊りましょうか。
romaji: odori mashouka.
meaning: Let's dance, shall we?

japanese: 彼女は私に泳ぎ方を教えてくれた。
romaji: kanojo wa watashi ni oyogihouwooshie tekureta.
meaning: She taught me how to swim.

japanese: 家に帰りましょうか。
romaji: ie ni kaeri mashouka.
meaning: Why don't we go home?

japanese: これは代わりになるものをみつけたい単語だ。
romaji: koreha kawari ninarumonowomitsuketai tango da.
meaning: It's a word I'd like to find a substitute for.

japanese: 答えが分かったんだ、でもあまりにすぐに分かったものだから正解であるはずがないんだ。
romaji: kotae ga waka ttanda, demoamarinisuguni waka ttamonodakara seikai dearuhazuganainda.
meaning: I found a solution, but I found it so fast that it can't be the right solution.

japanese: ワインにはいろいろなタイプがあり、それによって育成の仕方もさまざまです。
romaji: wain nihairoirona taipu gaari, soreniyotte ikusei no shikata mosamazamadesu.
meaning: There are various types of wines and the way they are matured varies accordingly.

japanese: 僕は水泳が下手やねん。
romaji: bokuhasuiei ga heta yanen.
meaning: I'm not very good at swimming.

japanese: 僕は寝坊して学校に遅刻した。
romaji: bokuhanebou shite gakkou ni chikoku shita.
meaning: I overslept and was late for school.

japanese: 私は花見に行ってきました。
romaji: watashi wa hanami ni itte kimashita.
meaning: I have been to see the cherry blossoms.

japanese: 今朝は髪の毛が撥ねてるんだ。せめて手鏡を貸してくれ、そこの引き出しにしまってあるだろ。
romaji: kesa wa kaminoke ga hane terunda. semete tekagami o kashi tekure, sokono hikidashi nishimattearudaro.
meaning: My hair's messed up this morning. At least lend me a hand mirror - it should be shut in the drawer there.

japanese: 朝起きて、挨拶を交わす相手がいる——久しぶりの感覚だ。
romaji: asaoki te, aisatsu o majiwa su aite gairu — — hisashi burino kankaku da.
meaning: To get up in the morning, and there be someone to say good morning to - I haven't had this feeling for a long time.

japanese: 妹はせっかちだからよく忘れ物をする。
romaji: imouto hasekkachidakarayoku wasuremono wosuru.
meaning: My sister is always in such a hurry that she often leaves things behind.

japanese: 仕込みはだいたい終わりましたし・・・、一眠りしていらしたらどうですか？
romaji: shikomi hadaitai owari mashitashi ・・・, ichinemuri shiteirashitaradoudesuka ？
meaning: We've nearly finished preparations. How about taking a nap?

japanese: あ、そうだ。まゆに変なことしたら、背骨を折る。
romaji: a, souda. mayuni henna kotoshitara, sebone o oru.
meaning: One more thing. If you try anything on Mayu I'll break your spine.

japanese: 折れるより曲がれ。
romaji: ore ruyori magare.
meaning: Better to bend than break.

japanese: 野菜の値段は日々変わる。
romaji: yasai no nedan wa hibikawa ru.
meaning: The price of vegetables varies from day to day.

japanese: 毎晩夜更かししていると、体を壊すよ。
romaji: maibanyofukashi shiteiruto, karada o kowasu yo.
meaning: It'll do harm to you to sit up late every night.

japanese: その建物はいつ壊れるかもしれない。
romaji: sono tatemono haitsu koware rukamoshirenai.
meaning: The building may crash at any time.

japanese: 家賃の支払いが5日を過ぎると、延滞料金が加算されます。
romaji: yachin no shiharai ga 5 nichi o sugi ruto, entairyoukin ga kasan saremasu.
meaning: If your rent comes in past the fifth, a late charge will be added.

japanese: 木がどすんと音を立てて倒れるのが聞こえた。
romaji: ki gadosunto oto o tate te taore runoga kiko eta.
meaning: The tree was heard to crash to the ground.

japanese: 動き出すとき、ベルが「ちんちん」と鳴る。だから、ちんちん電車。
romaji: ugokidasu toki, beru ga ( chinchin) to naru. dakara, chinchin densha.
meaning: When it sets off the bell rings, "ding-ding". Thus 'ding-ding-train'.

japanese: 流れを渡っている間に馬を取り替えるな。
romaji: nagare o watatsu teiru maniuma o torikae runa.
meaning: Never swap horses while crossing a stream.

japanese: 彼女が父親の死の悲しみから立ち直るには長い時間がかかるだろう。
romaji: kanojo ga chichioya no shinokanashimi kara tachinaoru niha nagaijikan gakakarudarou.
meaning: It'll be a long time before she gets over her father's death.

japanese: 流言飛語に惑わされるべからず、とはいうものの、言うは易く行うは難し、と思わない？
romaji: ryuugenhigo ni madowa sarerubekarazu, tohaiumonono, iu wa yasukuokonau wa muzukashi, to omowa nai ？
meaning: They say you shouldn't take rumors seriously, but that's easier said than done.
